Job Information



Job title *

YouTube Video Editor (Premiere Pro) — 3 Videos Due This Month





Video Editor (YouTube)



TYPE OF EMPLOYMENT *

Freelance / Project-based



Job description *

I’m hiring a Premiere Pro editor to complete 3 YouTube-format videos this month.



Scope & Deliverables



Edit 3 videos for YouTube (16:9, 1080p or 4K, optimized for upload).



Clean up and fix minor audio issues (noise, levels, pops) as best as possible.



Add simple captions, light color correction, and royalty-free music if needed.



Export final MP4 + deliver project files (.prproj) and assets on request.



Schedule & Milestones (September 2025)



Hire date: Wednesday, Sept 3



Kickoff / consultation call: Thursday, Sept 4 (time to be agreed; GMT-4 / New York)



Video #1 due: Sept 10



Video #2 due: Sept 17



Video #3 due: Sept 20



What I’ll provide



Footage, references, and editing notes for each video.



Any logos/brand assets needed.



Requirements



Strong Adobe Premiere Pro skills (must edit in Premiere Pro).



Experience fixing common audio issues.



Reliable internet and ability to meet deadlines.



Clear communication in English.



Nice to have (not required)



Thumbnail prep, basic motion graphics, and YouTube best practices.



Budget / Pay

US$120 total for the project (all 3 videos). Payment released upon completion of each milestone or in full on final delivery—your choice.



How to apply (fast screening)



Send 2–3 links to recent YouTube edits you’ve done (ideally with audio cleanup).



Briefly describe your audio-fix workflow in Premiere Pro.



Start your subject line with “Blue Pineapple” so I know you read this.



Timezone

Client is in America/New_York (GMT-4).



wage/salary per month *

US$120 (fixed project fee for September)



Desired no. of hours per week

10–15 hours/week until Sept 20

title: Online Arbitrage Virtual Assistant
description:
ONLINE ARBITRAGE

Looking to grow our team of 3 Seeking one part time position who will undergo a trial period of one week before being brought on. 



We are more than an Amazon arbitrage (OA) business. If you seek a long term, advancing position, this is for you.



PSA

We have systems in place to ensure we don’t bring on any bad actors. If you plan on sending us leads that are being shared across other businesses or you are pulling items off of a leads list, you will be let go immediately.



We are seeking a full time product sourcer who can grow in our company and later be promoted to a higher paid managerial role. If you are not a hard worker and can’t prove it to us over our interview process, don’t even bother completing this application.



Job Responsibilities

Tasked with sourcing in-stock 5-10 leads a day.



Follow up, build and maintain SOPs.



Requirements

Keepa experience required

Seller Amp (SAS) experience

Online Arbitrage experience

Familiar with manual, reverse/storefront stalking, keepa product finder

Understanding ROI, margin and sales rank

Ability to work Part-Time (20 hours per week)

Reliable internet Compensation & Benefits

Unlimited PTO

Holidays Off

Bonuses which will be discussed

Communication Skills



This should be simple, we're looking for people who don't need much supervision. Someone that is dependable and eager to work. We know this is a very competitive market and we are looking for a rockstar team member we can rely on for years and years to come. We need someone who pays attention to detail and understands how to properly read data. We expect the majority of the items to be shared with our team to be purchasable and pass all of our SOP checks.  Loyalty is the most important thing to our team. We're looking for people who want to stay with us long term and can see themselves in management /senior roles. If you've read this far, congratulations as I've found out many don't. Please put your favorite fruit as the title of your application.

Furthermore, we will not be accepting any candidates who already work for another client as we need exclusivity. 



If you want your application expedited please send over 3 leads researched from the same day of your application. 

Include Supplier Link & Amazon US link.

This is our criteria.

Low sales rank

Minimum 30% ROI

Keepa chart shows low odds of going below break even price



In addition please answer the following questions in your application submission.

Have you been previously employed to be an online arbitrage sourcer?

If so, why did you leave your current candidate?

How many monitors do you have?

Why should we choose you as one of our candidates?

What is your favorite sport and why ?  

Do you have a Seller Amp and Keepa subscription?



Thanks for taking the time out of your day to apply, best of luck!

title: ISA
description:
Inside Sales Agent (ISA)



Position: Inside Sales Agent (ISA)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: Remote

Compensation: Competitive base pay + performance incentives



About the Role



We are looking for a motivated, confident, and results-driven Inside Sales Agent (ISA) to join our team. The ISA will be responsible for responding to inbound leads, following up with prospective customers, qualifying opportunities, and scheduling appointments for our sales team.



The ideal candidate is comfortable speaking with prospects over the phone, can build rapport quickly, follows up consistently, and is motivated by achieving measurable sales goals.



Responsibilities

Respond promptly to new inbound leads via phone, text, and
.

Make outbound calls to prospective customers and follow up with existing leads.

Qualify leads based on their needs, timeline, and level of interest.

Build rapport and establish trust with potential customers.

Schedule qualified appointments for the sales team.

Maintain accurate lead and customer information in the CRM.

Follow up consistently with leads who are not yet ready to move forward.

Track calls, conversations, appointments, and results.

Meet or exceed daily and monthly performance goals.

Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to improve lead conversion.

Provide feedback regarding lead quality and common customer questions or objections.

Requirements

Previous experience in inside sales, appointment setting, telemarketing, customer service, or a similar role preferred.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Confident and professional phone presence.

Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

Ability to handle rejection and remain positive.

Comfortable working with CRM systems and basic technology.

Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.

Goal-oriented with a strong desire to earn and succeed.

Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.

What We're Looking For



The right candidate is someone who:



Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Follows up relentlessly without being pushy or unprofessional.

Listens well and understands the prospect's needs.

Can confidently overcome common objections.

Is coachable and willing to improve.

Takes ownership of their numbers and results.

Understands that consistent activity leads to consistent results.

Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by key performance indicators such as:



Number of calls and follow-ups completed

Lead response time

Qualified leads

Appointments scheduled

Appointment show rate

Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

Overall sales contribution

Compensation & Growth



We offer competitive compensation with performance-based incentives. High-performing team members will have opportunities for increased responsibility, additional earning potential, and career growth within the company.



How to Apply



If you're confident on the phone, highly motivated, and enjoy turning leads into real sales opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining why you would be a great fit for this position.

title: Data Anylist
description:
Position: Full-Time Excel & Business Data Analyst

Hours: 40 hours/week

Rate: Starting at $5/hour, negotiable based on skills and experience

Location: Remote / Work from Home

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Excel & Business Data Analyst to join our team.

This is not an entry-level bookkeeping position. We need someone who is highly analytical, excellent with numbers, and very experienced with Excel and data analysis.

You will work with large amounts of information involving work orders, employee time, job costs, credit card transactions, receipts, QuickBooks, and Shopify. Your job will be to analyze the information, identify discrepancies, and help ensure that our jobs and materials are being properly tracked and remain profitable.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze work orders, timesheets, timecards, and employee hours

Verify that employee hours are properly assigned and billed to the correct jobs

Identify missing or unbilled hours

Analyze credit card transactions and receipts and ensure they are properly connected to the correct jobs

Review data entered by different team members and identify missing or incorrect information

Create and maintain Excel reports for management

Analyze job costs, sales, expenses, and profitability

Compare materials purchased against materials sold

Analyze Shopify sales reports and compare them with purchasing and accounting records

Identify unusual transactions, discrepancies, and potential financial losses

Assist with reviewing QuickBooks records and reconciliations

Help review year-end financial records and identify issues that need attention

Create reports and dashboards that make large amounts of data easy to understand

Help improve and organize our existing reporting and tracking processes

Work closely with management and other team members to ensure data is accurate and complete

Required Skills

Advanced Excel skills are required.

You should be comfortable with:

PivotTables

PivotCharts

VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP

IF formulas

SUMIF / SUMIFS

Data filtering and sorting

Data analysis and reporting

Creating professional spreadsheets

Building flowcharts

Working with large datasets

Connecting Excel with SharePoint

Identifying patterns, errors, and discrepancies in data

Software Experience

Experience with the following is strongly preferred:

Microsoft Excel – Advanced

QuickBooks

Shopify

Microsoft SharePoint

You do not need to know our exact systems or processes because we can train you on those. However, you must already have a strong understanding of Excel, data analysis, and financial/business reporting.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

Has excellent attention to detail

Is highly analytical and comfortable working with numbers

Can work independently without constant supervision

Has strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

Can identify problems instead of simply entering data

Is comfortable working with large amounts of information

Takes initiative and asks questions when something doesn't look right

Is dependable and interested in a long-term position

Has reliable, high-speed internet

Has a fast and reliable computer

Can work a consistent 40-hour work week

Important

This position requires someone who can analyze and understand the numbers, not simply enter information.

For example, if the company purchases a large amount of a particular material, the analyst should be able to compare the purchases against sales, calculate margins, identify discrepancies, and bring potential problems to management's attention.

We will train you on our specific work orders, systems, processes, and reporting requirements. However, we are not looking for someone who needs to be taught basic Excel or basic data analysis.

Compensation & Growth

Starting compensation is $5/hour, with the final rate negotiable depending on experience and demonstrated skills.

There is significant opportunity for growth and future pay increases for someone who proves their ability, takes initiative, and becomes an important part of the team.

This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

A brief description of your experience with advanced Excel and data analysis.

Your experience with QuickBooks and Shopify.

Examples of reports, dashboards, or Excel analysis you have created.

The Excel functions/features you are most comfortable using.

Your expected hourly rate.

Your available working hours and confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week.

Your internet speed and computer specifications.

Please do not apply if you only have basic Excel or basic bookkeeping experience.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate strong analytical ability and take ownership of this role.

title: American Income Life Appointment Setter
description:
# ???? Appointment Setter / Scheduler — U.S. Life Insurance Agency



We are looking for an **experienced, confident Appointment Setter** to work with a U.S.-based life insurance agency affiliated with **Globe Life American Income Life**.



This is **NOT** a passive virtual assistant position.



Your primary responsibility is simple:



**CALL. CONNECT. SCHEDULE. CONFIRM.**



You will be working leads by phone, following a proven script, handling basic objections, scheduling qualified appointments for licensed insurance agents, and helping make sure those appointments actually **SHOW UP**.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Make a high volume of outbound calls each day

* Contact leads provided by our agency

* Follow our appointment-setting scripts and process

* Handle common objections and rebuttals confidently

* Schedule appointments directly onto agents' calendars

* Confirm upcoming appointments

* Follow up with people who do not answer

* Reschedule cancellations and missed appointments

* Accurately update lead statuses and notes

* Track calls, contacts, appointments set, and appointments confirmed

* Communicate consistently with management



## ???? CLEAR SPOKEN ENGLISH IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You will be speaking with **American clients all day**, so your ability to communicate clearly over the phone is one of the most important qualifications for this position.



You MUST:



* Speak fluent, easy-to-understand English

* Have excellent pronunciation and phone presence

* Speak confidently and naturally

* Be able to build rapport quickly

* Understand American callers without difficulty

* Follow a script **without sounding like you're reading a script**



**A voice recording will be required before an interview.**



If callers regularly have difficulty understanding you over the phone, **this position is not a good fit.**



## Experience We Prefer



**Previous Globe Life / American Income Life experience is a MAJOR PLUS.**



We especially want to hear from you if you have previously worked as an:



* American Income Life Appointment Setter

* AIL Scheduler

* Globe Life Appointment Setter

* Life Insurance Appointment Setter

* Insurance Cold Caller

* Outbound Sales Representative



Experience with **AIL leads, union leads, POS/policyholder leads, appointment confirmations, Zoom appointments, scripts, rebuttals, and lead dispositions** is highly preferred.



If you do not have AIL experience, you should have strong previous experience in **high-volume outbound appointment setting or phone sales.**



## This Job Is NOT For You If:



* You are uncomfortable making a lot of phone calls

* You give up after calling someone once

* You are afraid of rejection

* You sound robotic when reading a script

* You struggle to speak clearly on the phone

* You need constant supervision to stay productive

* You disappear during scheduled working hours

* You consider leaving voi
s all day to be "working the leads"



We need someone **persistent, reliable, competitive, coachable, and results-driven.**



## What We Care About



We're not interested in someone telling us they were "busy all day."



**We care about results.**



Your performance will be measured by things such as:



**Calls ? Contacts ? Appointments Set ? Confirmations ? SHOWS**



If you're good on the phone, aggressive with follow-up, and know how to keep a calendar full, we want to talk to you.



## TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Your previous appointment-setting experience

2. Any **Globe Life / American Income Life experience**

3. How many outbound calls you are comfortable making per day

4. Your expected hourly rate

5. Your available working hours in **U.S. Central Time**

6. A link to a **30–60 second voice recording** introducing yourself and briefly explaining your appointment-setting experience



### IMPORTANT



Start your application with the words:



**"I CAN FILL A CALENDAR"**



Applications that do not follow this instruction may not be reviewed.



We're looking for somebody who can **pick up the phone, control the conversation, overcome basic objections, book the appointment, and move to the next call.**



**If that's you — apply.**

title: Offshore CPA
description:
Offshore CPA — Personal Injury Settlement File Cleanup & Audit (Contract, Litify + QBO) 



Type: Independent contractor, full-time hours (40 hrs/wk), fully remote/offshore Duration: 3–6 month cleanup engagement, with strong potential to convert to ongoing long-term work Openings: 2 Overlap required: Minimum 4 hours daily overlap with U.S. Central/Eastern business hours Start: ASAP 



About the work 



We are a personal injury law firm running case management in Litify (Salesforce) and accounting in QuickBooks Online. Our historical case files and settlement records need a disciplined financial cleanup: we are rebuilding client-level subledgers in QBO so that every matter reconciles cleanly against the trust account and against what Litify says happened on the case. 



This is not bookkeeping data entry. This is forensic file review — you will open a settlement file, reconstruct what actually happened financially, find where it broke, and fix it with documentation. 



 



What you will do 



Review closed and open personal injury settlement files end to end from a financial perspective 



Rebuild and maintain client trust (IOLTA) subledgers in QuickBooks Online — one per client/matter — and reconcile them three ways: subledger totals ? trust bank statement ? trust control account in the GL 



Audit settlement statements / disbursement sheets for accuracy: gross settlement, attorney fee calculation against the fee agreement percentage, case costs advanced, medical liens and provider balances, health insurance/ERISA/Medicare/Medicaid liens, referral fee splits, and net to client 



Trace every disbursement against supporting documentation (executed release, signed settlement statement, lien reduction letters, cost receipts, cleared checks) 



Reconcile Litify case financial records — matter records, settlement/negotiation objects, expense and lien records, related documents — against QBO and flag discrepancies 



Identify and document exceptions: unapplied funds, stale outstanding checks, negative client balances, commingling risk, costs never reimbursed to the firm, unreleased liens, missing signatures, math errors on the statement 



Clear the exception log by working with our case managers and attorneys, or escalate with a written recommendation 



Build and follow a repeatable review checklist; document your workpapers so a third party can follow them 



Report weekly on files reviewed, files cleared, exceptions open, and dollars at issue 



Required qualifications 



CPA or Chartered Accountant (or an equivalent recognized designation in your country) — please state your license/registration number and jurisdiction 



Hands-on Litify experience is required. You must have worked inside Litify day to day — not just generic Salesforce. Be prepared to describe specific Litify objects, page layouts, and reports you have used, and to demonstrate navigation during the interview 



Working knowledge of Salesforce navigation, list views, and report building 



Demonstrated experience with U.S. law firm trust/IOLTA accounting and three-way reconciliation 



Direct experience reviewing personal injury settlement statements, medical liens, and lien reductions 



Strong QuickBooks Online skills, including class/customer:job or project-level tracking used to produce client subledgers 



Advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, reconciliation workbooks) 



Excellent written English — you will be documenting findings that attorneys read and rely on 



Reliable high-speed internet, a private work environment, and a computer capable of running Salesforce and QBO simultaneously 



Nice to have 



Prior work with a U.S. plaintiff-side PI firm or a legal-accounting BPO 



Familiarity with Medicare Secondary Payer / conditional payment resolution and ERISA plan liens 



Experience with QBO cleanup projects and reconstructing prior-period records 



Exposure to LawPay, Gravity Legal, or similar legal payment processors 



Litify Financials / Litify Payments module experience 



What we care about most 



We would rather have one person who can look at a settlement statement and immediately see that the fee was calculated on the wrong base, the lien was reduced but never rebooked, and the client was short-paid $1,840 — than three people who can only reconcile what they're handed. Judgment and skepticism matter more than speed.

title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT (Sales Ops) — $1,000–$1,500 USD PER MONTH
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Role



Salary: $1,000 per month starting, $1,500 per month after 90-day probation

Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



You will work directly with the Setter Manager inside a fast-growing online coaching company.

This is a hands-on Executive Assistant role focused on sales operations and oversight.

title: Outbound Sales Rep — Cold Calling US/CA/AU Small Businesses (Websites, $1K Offer)
description:
Full-time contractor (40 hrs/week) · Remote · Must work US business hours Pay: Base + per-sale commission (details below) Start: ASAP!



About us

We build fast, modern, professional websites for small local businesses — plumbers, HVAC and roofing contractors, landscapers, auto repair shops, dental and chiropractic offices, family restaurants, small law and accounting practices.



Most of these owners have been in business 10, 20, 30 years. They have great reviews and steady customers — and either no website at all, or one built in 2009 that doesn't work on a phone. They're not tech people and they don't want to become tech people.



Our offer is deliberately simple: a complete, professional website, delivered in days, for a flat $1,000. No monthly retainer required to get started, no 6-week agency process, no jargon.



We're a small team. You'd be our first dedicated sales hire, working directly with the founder.



What you'll do

* Build your own call list. You'll source small businesses in the US, Canada, and Australia that have no website or a badly outdated one — using Google Maps, local directories, and the tools we point you to. We'll teach you exactly how we do it and give you the criteria; you own the execution and keep the pipeline full.

* Make outbound calls to those owners — you're calling businesses you qualified yourself, so you already know why they need us

* Run the conversation from opener to close: get the owner on the phone, get them interested in 30 seconds, handle the "I don't need a website" objections, and close the $1,000 deal

* Book and run short follow-up calls where needed (many owners need 2–3 touches)

* Send follow-up texts and
s to warm leads

* Log every call, outcome, and note in our CRM — accurately, every time

* Hand off closed clients cleanly to our developer with the info he needs to build

* Tell us what you're hearing on the phone: which industries bite, which objections keep coming up, which parts of the pitch fall flat. Your feedback shapes the offer.



Targets

* ~80–120 dials per day, 40 hours/week — roughly 6 hours on the phone, up to 2 hours building and cleaning your list

* At least 100 new qualified leads added to the pipeline each week

* 10 closed deals per month is the target and what the commission plan is built around

* Ramp: we expect first sale within week 2, and target volume by month 2



You're a fit if you have:

* Fluent, natural English — near-native or neutral accent. Small business owners in the US hang up on people they struggle to understand. This is non-negotiable and we screen for it first.

* 2+ years of outbound B2B phone sales, ideally cold calling small/local businesses

* A track record of closing on the phone, not just booking appointments for someone else

* Willingness to build your own lists. This is not a role where a list lands in your inbox every Monday. You'll be researching businesses on Google Maps and directories yourself. We teach you the method — but if hunting for your own leads sounds like beneath you, this isn't the job.

* Comfort with rejection — you'll hear "no" 90+ times a day and still sound fresh on call 100

* Reliable setup: quiet workspace, wired/fiber internet (10+ Mbps up), noise-cancelling USB headset, backup power and backup internet

* Availability for US business hours (roughly 8am–5pm ET / PT depending on the territory you're calling). We'll set a fixed schedule together.

* Discipline to self-manage — nobody is standing over your shoulder



Bonus points

* You've sold to home services, trades, restaurants, or medical/dental offices

* You've sold web design, digital marketing, SEO, or software to non-technical buyers

* You're comfortable with dialers (Close, Aircall, JustCall, Kixie, or similar) and CRMs (HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive)

* You can write a decent follow-up
 without help



Compensation

* Base: $500 USD/month, paid [semi-monthly / weekly]

* Commission: $80 per closed deal, paid after the client's payment clears. No cap.

* At target (10 deals/month): $1,300 USD/month. 15 deals in a month is $1,700.



What we provide

* Training on our lead-sourcing method — the exact search criteria, tools, and filters we use to find businesses with no website. You build the list; we make sure you're not guessing how.

* Dialer, CRM, and business phone numbers

* A tested call script, objection-handling doc, and portfolio of finished sites to send

* Fast delivery on the back end, so what you promise on the phone actually happens — you'll never have to apologize for a missed deadline



How to apply

Applications without all three items will not be reviewed.



1. A 60–90 second voice recording (audio file or Loom link) where you cold-call a fictional plumbing company owner named Mike and pitch our $1,000 website. Start from your opener — pretend he just picked up and said "Yeah? Who's this?"

2. In writing, 3–5 sentences: the owner says "I already have a
 page, I don't need a website." What do you say next?

3. Your numbers from a past role: dials per day, connect rate, close rate, and what you were selling. Be specific — we'd rather see real modest numbers than vague big ones.



Start your application with the word "DIAL" so we know you read this.



We reply to every applicant who completes all three steps. Shortlisted candidates do one 20-minute live call with the founder, including a short role-play. Hiring within 2 weeks.

title: Senior VA – Project & Operations Coordinator | Turn Ideas Into Completed Projects (AI-Savvy)
description:
Senior Virtual Assistant — Project & Operations Coordinator

Part-time | Approx. 10 hours/week to start | Genuine growth path



We are an established Australian property consultancy entering an exciting new phase of growth, systems development and AI-enabled operations.



We are looking for an exceptional Senior Virtual Assistant / Project & Operations Coordinator who can help turn business decisions into completed execution.



This is NOT a traditional task-based VA position.

We don’t want someone who needs to be given every individual step.



We’re looking for someone who can be given an outcome, understand what needs to happen, organise the work, coordinate people and resources, use AI intelligently, follow up, and make sure things actually get completed.



You naturally think three steps ahead. You don’t wait to be chased — you’re already thinking about the next step. 

You notice what’s missing before it becomes a problem and take pride in being the calm, capable person who keeps things moving behind the scenes.



EXAMPLE OF WHAT THIS LOOKS LIKE



“We are launching an online investor event in four weeks. This is the outcome we want.”



Rather than waiting for a detailed list of instructions, we want you to be able to determine:



• What needs to happen, and what needs to happen first

• What tasks need to be created, and who should do each one

• What AI can help with

• What systems or tools are required

• What genuinely requires the Founder’s decision

• What deadlines need managing and following up

• How we know the project is DONE



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES MAY INCLUDE



• Turning approved priorities into project plans

• Project and operations coordination

• Coordinating existing VAs and contractors, delegating and following up

• Using AI extensively for research, planning, drafting and problem-solving

• Managing timelines and dependencies

• Quality-checking work against our standards

• Creating and improving SOPs and checklists

• Identifying blockers before they become problems

• Escalating genuine decisions — not routine ones

• Closing loops and ensuring work is actually completed



YOU’RE LIKELY A STRONG FIT IF



• You naturally organise chaos without being told how

• You’re exceptionally reliable and finish what you start

• You take ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks

• You think ahead and don’t wait to be chased

• You notice when something is missing or doesn’t look right — and speak up

• You’re confident and independent using AI as part of everyday work

• You communicate warmly, clearly and concisely — no long-winded updates

• You know the difference between “I’ll just d
 this” and “I need to ask”

• You notice details and follow instructions carefully

• You’re comfortable coordinating other people and keeping multiple moving parts on track

• You’re a self-starter, a fast learner and a proactive problem-solver



EXPERIENCE WE VALUE



Experience in some combination of the following is valuable:



• Senior VA or Executive Assistant work

• Project or operations coordination

• Business administration

• Team or contractor coordination

• CRM and project-management software

• AI tools such as ChatGPT or similar

• SOP and process creation

• Google Workspace,
 marketing platforms, Canva or similar business tools



Property or premium-service experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

You do not need property industry experience — we care far more about how you think, organise, communicate and execute.



STARTING COMMITMENT

Approximately 10 hours per week.

This is deliberately small to start — we’re testing fit and the working relationship, not filling a full-time seat.

For the right person, there is real potential to grow as responsibilities and the business expand.

________________________________________



HOW TO APPLY



Please read this section carefully.

Begin your application with the words:

I CLOSE LOOPS

Then answer these five questions in this exact order:



1. OUTCOME OWNERSHIP

Tell us about one real situation where you were given an outcome rather than a detailed task list.

What was the outcome, how did you determine what needed to happen, and what was the final result?



2. AI

Which AI tools do you currently use in your work?

Give us one specific example of something you have personally used AI to accomplish that saved time, improved quality or solved a problem.



3. PROJECT COORDINATION

Imagine three people are responsible for different parts of a project and one person is late, which is now blocking the other two.

What would you do?



4. YOUR ONLINEJOBS.PH PROFILE

Please provide:

• Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link

• Your current ID Proof score

• Your current availability

• Your expected hourly rate



5. WHY THIS ROLE?

In no more than 100 words, tell us why this particular role interests you.



ONE FINAL INSTRUCTION

Please keep your entire initial application to 400 words or fewer.

Please do not send a generic cover letter.



We are looking for people who can read carefully, think independently, communicate clearly and take ownership of outcomes.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical project-coordination exercise.

title: UAT and End User Tester
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented User Acceptance Testing  (UAT)  and User Specialist to validate end-to-end business workflows and user journeys across our native app. In this role, you will test technical application, and end users usability and business acceptance criteria before public deployment.



Key Responsibilities

• Test Execution & User Validation: Execute end-to-end UAT test scenarios and exploratory testing on desktop, real iOS and Android devices, focusing on user journeys, permissions, push notifications, and offline/online state transitions.

• Scenario & Test Plan Design: Translate application requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria into realistic, business-focused UAT test cases.

• Defect Management: Identify, document, and triage functional, and performance defects in the app, detailing clear steps to show issues, log the issues found, screen recordings, and expected outcomes.

• Build Distribution & Release Readiness: Manage and test pre-production builds via TestFlight (iOS) and Google Play Console Internal/Closed Testing tracks.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Closely work with Developer, Creator Product Managers, to validate bug fixes, clarify ambiguous behaviors, and sign off on updates and releases.

• Hardware & OS Compatibility: Validate app performance across varying screen sizes, Mobile versions, network constraints (3G, 4G, 5G, Wi-Fi, airplane mode), and device configurations (biometrics, camera access, battery saving modes).



Required Qualifications & Skills

• Experience: 2–4+ years of experience in QA/UAT testing, with a dedicated focus on native and mobile applications (iOS and Android).

• Platform Familiarity: Strong working knowledge of platform-specific design (Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Google Material Design).

• Build Tools: Practical experience using Apple TestFlight and Google Play Console for beta distribution and build tracking.

• Tooling: Proficiency with test management and issue-tracking software (e.g., Jira)

• Device Debugging: Familiarity with capturing mobile logs and crash reports.

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical flaws and requirements in clear business terms.

title: Phone Support - Neutral Accent & Fluent English
description:
The Role



We're looking for someone who knows how to bring calm to a hard conversation, earn a customer's trust, and then make things right.



You'll take inbound escalated calls for one of our food supplement brands, helping customers who need more patience, reassurance, or care than a standard support interaction gets. When a conversation needs a steady hand, you're the one we trust to take it from there.



A Little About Us



Raicom LLC runs a growing portfolio of consumer brands. We've learned customers remember less about whether their problem got solved, and more about how it felt while it was being solved. This role protects that second part.



You'll Be Great Here If You

- Communicate naturally on the phone with a neutral or near native English accent

- Have 1–2+ years of customer service or call center experience

- Have handled escalated or high-emotion calls before, or you're exceptionally composed under pressure by nature

- Listen for what a customer actually needs, not just the first thing they say

- Make reasonable decisions within guidelines without needing everything spelled out

- Stay empathetic without losing control of the conversation

- Write clear, useful notes and follow through on what you say you'll do

- Have reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional space to take calls



Previous phone or voice support experience is a strong plus. More than anything: we care about how you make people feel when things aren't going smoothly.



To apply, write NATIVE in your subject line and submit a short video recording answering the following questions:



1. Walk us through a call where the customer was right to be angry — not just upset, but justified. What did you actually say to them, word for word if you can remember, and what did you do after the call ended?

2. Tell us about a call that almost got to you — where you felt yourself about to react badly. What was happening, and what did you do in that exact moment to pull it back?

3. Have you worked an overnight or graveyard shift before? If yes, how long did you last, and what made you stop or stay?

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

title: EXPERIENCED CREDIT REPAIR DISPUTE SPECIALIST
description:
**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Monday–Friday**



We are hiring a **highly experienced Credit Repair Dispute Specialist** to join our U.S.-based credit repair company.



**THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION.**



We are NOT looking for someone who wants to learn credit repair from scratch. You must already have real, hands-on experience working for a credit repair company and understand how the dispute process works.



You will receive **2 weeks of training on OUR specific dispute letter writing system, strategies, procedures, and standards.**



## YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing client credit reports from Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

* Identifying negative, inaccurate, inconsistent, outdated, or questionable reporting

* Writing and preparing customized credit dispute letters

* Managing client disputes inside **Credit Repair Cloud**

* Following the correct dispute sequence for each client

* Reviewing previous dispute rounds before preparing the next round

* Tracking bureau and creditor responses

* Updating client files accurately after every dispute round

* Maintaining detailed notes and documentation

* Following our company's dispute procedures exactly

* Managing multiple client files without allowing details to be missed



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have previous professional experience with:



* U.S. credit repair

* Credit dispute letters

* Credit Repair Cloud or comparable credit repair software

* Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion credit reports

* Collections

* Charge-offs

* Late payments

* Repossessions

* Hard inquiries

* Derogatory accounts

* Multiple rounds of disputes

* Dispute sequencing and follow-up strategies

* Reading and understanding bureau investigation results



Knowledge of the **FCRA, FDCPA, Metro 2 reporting, CFPB complaints, direct furnisher disputes, and method-of-verification procedures** is strongly preferred.



## QUALITY IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN SPEED



We are not looking for someone who simply processes the largest number of clients possible.



**ACCURACY > SPEED.**



Every client's file must be handled carefully.



A dispute letter sent with the wrong account, wrong bureau, wrong dispute reason, incorrect information, or incorrect sequence can negatively affect a client's case.



We would rather you complete **20 files correctly than 40 files incorrectly.**



You must be someone who checks your work before submitting it.



## YOU WILL BE TESTED BEFORE YOU ARE HIRED



Do not apply simply because you have “Credit Repair” listed on your resume.



Qualified applicants will complete a **Credit Repair Knowledge Assessment** before being selected.



You may be tested on:



1. Credit report analysis

2. Identifying reporting problems

3. Selecting appropriate dispute strategies

4. Dispute sequencing

5. Credit Repair Cloud knowledge

6. Writing a sample dispute letter

7. Determining what should happen after an account is verified

8. Identifying mistakes in a sample client dispute file



We are looking for someone who can **think**, not simply copy and paste templates.



## 2-WEEK PROBATIONARY TRAINING



Candidates who pass the initial assessment will enter a **2-week probationary training period.**



During these two weeks, you will learn:



* Our dispute philosophy

* Our letter-writing system

* Our dispute sequences

* Our Credit Repair Cloud workflow

* Our documentation standards

* Our quality-control process



You will be evaluated on:



**Accuracy • Attention to Detail • Ability to Follow Instructions • Credit Knowledge • Reliability • Written English • Organization • Quality of Work**



Training is paid upon successful completion of the two-week training/probationary period.



## SCHEDULE



**Full-Time**



Monday through Friday

5 days per week



This is intended to be a **long-term position** for the right person.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



You are someone who:



* Has already worked in the U.S. credit repair industry

* Takes pride in accurate work

* Pays extreme attention to detail

* Understands that every client's credit file is different

* Can follow a system without taking shortcuts

* Can work independently

* Is dependable Monday through Friday

* Communicates when you don't understand something

* Doesn't guess when handling a client's file

* Can accept corrections and improve quickly

* Wants a stable, long-term position



## HOW TO APPLY



Send the following:



1. Your resume

2. How many years you have worked in credit repair

3. Names of credit repair software you have used

4. Your experience with Credit Repair Cloud

5. Approximately how many client files you managed at your previous company

6. Your expected monthly salary in USD

7. Your availability

8. Your internet speed

9. A brief explanation of the dispute process you used at your previous credit repair company



**FINAL QUESTION:**



A client's collection account was disputed with Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion. Thirty days later, Equifax deleted the account, but Experian and TransUnion verified it.



**What would you review before d
 what dispute should be sent next, and why?**



Please answer in your own words.



**AI-generated or copied answers may result in disqualification.**



We are looking for a serious Credit Repair Dispute Specialist who wants to grow with our company.



**If you do not already have credit repair experience, please do not apply.**

title: Customer Success and Retention Manager – $2,000 Base p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

title: Junior Performance Creative Producer | Paid Test to Full-Time Role
description:
We are a Swedish e-commerce company with multiple brands, and we are looking for a **full-time Creative Strategist / Video Editor** to join our growing creative team.



You do NOT need 10 years of experience. But you should have worked with performance creatives before and understand what makes an ad convert.



### What you will do



* Research customers, competitors, reviews and winning ads

* Find strong angles, desires, problems and hooks

* Turn research into high-converting scripts

* Source or create the material needed for the ads

* Edit complete Meta ad creatives yourself

* Analyze creative performance and understand WHY something worked or failed

* Use those learnings to create better iterations and new winners



We are not looking for someone who can simply edit a nice-looking video.



We want someone who understands **performance marketing and creative strategy**.



### The Brand



You will initially work with **Scarlet Intimates**, one of our Scandinavian e-commerce brands selling leak-proof period underwear.



Our two largest customer groups are:



**1. Mothers buying for their daughters**



Our biggest angle is mothers preparing their daughters for their first period. They want their daughter to feel prepared, confident and protected instead of worrying about leaks, pads or getting her first period unexpectedly.



**2. Adult women**



Women looking for a better alternative to pads. Something that looks and feels more like normal underwear while being comfortable, dry and reliable against leaks.



It removes the wet, bulky and uncomfortable feeling many women experience with pads while also being a nicer-looking, reusable and more economical solution.



Understanding the customer deeply and turning these desires and problems into strong advertising is a major part of this job.



### IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION



Before writing anything else in your application, your FIRST line must be:



**PURPLE BANANA | [the city you currently live in] | [your favorite food] | [the editing software you personally use the most]**



Example format only:



PURPLE BANANA | Your City | Your Favorite Food | Your Editing Software



Do not copy the example answers.



We added this because we only want applications from people who have actually read the entire job post.



**If your application does not start with this line, we will not review it.**



### Paid Test



Before we hire you, you will complete **2 finished test creatives**.



We will provide you with a detailed test brief containing information about the brand, customers and existing research.



However, we also expect you to **do your own research**.



You are responsible for taking the brief and turning it into two complete ads, including:



* Research

* Angle/hook

* Script

* Voiceover if needed

* Sourcing or creating footage

* AI-generated material if needed

* Editing

* Final finished advertisement



The test pays **$50 total if the test brief has been properly followed.**



This is important:



**Do NOT treat these as quick test videos.**



We want to see the exact quality you would deliver if you were already working for us full-time.



If you normally would spend additional time researching, finding better footage, improving the hook or creating better assets, then do that in the test too.



We are not looking for the bare minimum.



We want to see your **best actual working standard from day one**.



You can use tools such as:



ChatGPT, Claude, Nano Banana Pro, ElevenLabs, Kling and other AI or editing tools.



For the test, you are responsible for the tools you choose to use.



**If you are hired, we will provide the AI tools needed for your ongoing work.**



### Long-Term Opportunity



We already have another Creative Strategist working with us and we are now building a larger creative team.



This is not a short freelance project.



We are looking for someone who can work with us **full-time and long-term, potentially for years.**



Starting salary is:



**$400–$750/month + performance bonuses**



If your creatives perform well, there is room to:



* Earn performance bonuses

* Increase your salary

* Take on more responsibility

* Work on additional brands

* Grow into a larger role within the company



We care much more about **how good you are and how quickly you improve** than how many years of experience you have.



We are looking for a hidden A-player who understands advertising, takes the work seriously and wants to become extremely good at creating winning e-commerce creatives.

title: Operations & Delivery Manager

Manager to keep plasterboard deliveries, supplier orders and small public repair jobs moving from initial request

through to completion. The right candidate will take real ownership of clients, suppliers and job organisation, with a

genuine pathway to leading our remote team. This is a long-term remote career opportunity for a Philippinesbased professional. It is not a short-term one- or two-year role.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Communicate confidently and professionally with clients, builders, site teams and suppliers by phone and
.

• Book and amend plasterboard deliveries, including Walk-in and Manitou deliveries.

• Coordinate site inspections, access requirements, delivery readiness and timing with suppliers and supervisors.

• Check schedules and current job documents when issues arise, contact the right person and work toward the

best available outcome.

• Prepare and check purchase orders, Mud Maps and supplier order documents before issue.

• Monitor supplier confirmations and order details, following discrepancies through to correction.

title: Amazon Seller Central VA
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Seller Central-focused Virtual Assistant to manage and optimize Amazon outbound shipment workflows. This role requires strong operational execution inside Amazon Seller Central, with a focus on shipment creation, shipment cost tracking, logistics coordination, inventory management, and placement fee analysis. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets, understands Amazon shipment methods including SPD, LTL, and FTL, and can accurately analyze shipment costs to support operational and financial decision-making.



Seller Central Shipment Management

This role is responsible for creating and managing Amazon shipment plans based on client-provided SKU and quantity requests. The successful candidate will coordinate shipments using SPD, LTL, and FTL methods, verify shipment accuracy, routing, carton counts, pallet configurations, and warehouse destinations, while proactively monitoring shipment statuses and resolving discrepancies. Maintaining accurate shipment documentation and tracking records is a critical part of the position.



Shipment Cost Analysis & Reporting

The candidate will review and analyze placement fees, transportation costs, split shipment impacts, and cost-per-unit shipping metrics. They will identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve operational efficiency while preparing recurring shipment cost summaries and reports that support business decision-making.



Data & Inventory Management

Responsibilities include maintaining accurate inventory levels across multiple warehouses and ensuring data consistency across reports. The role requires advanced use of Excel and Google Sheets for reporting, analysis, forecasting, and shipment planning. Strong attention to detail and data accuracy is essential.



Logistics Coordination

The successful candidate will coordinate with warehouses, prep centers, freight carriers, and internal teams to ensure smooth shipment execution. This includes scheduling and monitoring pickups and deliveries, assisting with freight coordination, and communicating shipment updates, delays, and exceptions clearly and promptly.



Required Qualifications

Candidates should have hands-on experience working inside Amazon Seller Central and a strong understanding of Amazon shipment workflows. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets is required, along with strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. The ability to work independently, manage repetitive operational tasks with a high degree of accuracy, and communicate effectively in writing is essential. Candidates who are detail-oriented and follow instructions carefully tend to excel in this role. When submitting your application, start the subject line with Capybara followed by your name.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience coordinating FTL freight shipments, familiarity with freight portals and logistics software, and knowledge of inventory planning and supply chain operations are highly valued. Additional experience with SPS Commerce, EDI workflows, Amazon B2B operations, routing requests, ASN management, retailer compliance requirements, freight appointments, carrier communications, and Vendor Central workflows will be considered an advantage.

title: Social Media Project Manager
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a dedicated Virtual Assistant to own the daily execution of a growing digital education business. You'll handle content posting, customer DM conversations, funnel building, and administrative systems, freeing the founder to focus on strategy and sales. This is a hands-on execution role, not a general assistant position. You should be able to take a punch list and run with it, with minimal hand-holding.



You'll also need to manage multiple projects at once, some back to back and some running simultaneously, without losing track of any of them. Must be proficient with spreadsheets.



This is a 100?dicated role. You must be fully available and not splitting time with other clients.

 To Apply, send an
 with a cover letter, resume and complete the following tasks:



1. Design a flyer in Canva

What to ask them to do: "Using the free version of Canva, create a simple flyer for a homeschool co-op Interest Meeting for August 30th at 6pmEST. The flyer should gauge interest in starting a Lego League team, specifically for high school students. It should be eye-catching, easy to read at a glance, and include a clear next step (for example, a place to sign up or express interest). Send us the design link, QR code or an exported image.





2. Sign up for a free 
 account and build a simple one-page opt-in landing page for a fictional free guide called 'Estate Plan Readiness Checklist.' Include a headline, a short description, and an
 capture form. Send us the preview link when you're done."





What You'll Do

Content posting: Post scheduled content daily across Instagram,
, YouTube, and LinkedIn; track performance and flag when content is ready to boost

Content editing: Edit and re-cut video content using tools like Descript (trimming, captions, re-cutting long-form into shorter clips) to keep the posting schedule full

Customer outreach: Send DMs per day, respond to inbound messages, and route warm leads to the right next step (never a hard pitch)

Funnel & tech support: Build and update funnel pages, checkout flows, and
 sequences; test everything before calling it done

Admin & projects: Keep trackers and files organized, manage multiple overlapping projects, do independent research to fill gaps, and handle paperwork accurately

AI & tools: Use AI tools (like Claude) as part of daily execution, and learn new platforms quickly as the business needs them

What We're Looking For



Executes from a punch list independently, catches your own mistakes, and flags issues before being asked

Comfortable managing several projects at once, including overlapping ones, without dropping the ball

Resourceful: researches first, brings back answers or recommendations

Comfortable with technology and funnels; willing to learn new tools fast

Proficient with video editing tools (Descript or similar). Comfortable trimming, captioning, and re-cutting content

Fast, direct communication style; thrives with quick turnarounds

Prior experience with digital products, funnels, or coaching businesses is a plus

No niche or industry background required. Attention to detail and follow-through matter most

What Success Looks Like

Content and DM quotas hit consistently, tracked without reminders

Funnel fixes executed correctly the first time

Projects stay on track even when multiple are running at once

The founder stops having to double-check whether something got done

Compensation



Base pay plus bonus opportunities for hitting key milestones and sales goals.



Reports directly to the founder. Daily async updates, weekly check-in on priorities.

title: Short-Form Video Editor - Personal Brand Content
description:
Short-Form Video Editor for Personal Brand Content



We work with founders who build their audience on camera. We are looking for a Short-Form Video Editor who can turn raw footage into scroll-stopping TikToks, Reels and Shorts that hold attention to the last second.



This is founder content, not product ads. The founder is the story. That means talking-head clips one day and a lifestyle cut the next: travel, office, city, behind the scenes, day-in-the-life. Same job either way - make people stay.



What you will do:

- Edit 20-30 short-form videos per week across both brands

- Cut long-form footage (podcasts, lives, vlogs, phone recordings) into standalone clips that work on their own

- Build lifestyle and B-roll edits from raw daily footage: travel, office, events, behind the scenes

- Build hooks that land in the first 1-2 seconds and hold retention throughout

- Add captions, text overlays, b-roll, music and sound design, and native TikTok pacing

- Keep each founder's voice and look consistent across every clip



Requirements:

- Proven experience editing short-form content, both talking-head and lifestyle or B-roll driven (portfolio required)

- CapCut Pro or Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro

- Strong instinct for retention editing: pacing, cuts, pattern interrupts

- A feel for music: cutting to the beat and picking sound that carries a lifestyle clip

- Excellent English so captions and hook text are always correct

- Reliable communication and fast turnaround

- Comfortable taking feedback and iterating quickly



What we offer

- Long-term collaboration, not one-off gigs

- Consistent weekly workload across two brands

- Reliable payments that will grow over time

- Direct communication with our team and clear briefs



How to apply:

Send us:

- 3 examples of short-form videos you edited, with links. At least one talking-head and one lifestyle or B-roll edit

- Your monthly salary expectation



Start your application with "HOOK"



Applications without portfolio links and / or the word HOOK will not be considered.

etings

title: Systems Administrator
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Ph)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST (with flexibility as needed for client impact events)



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team MSPs rely on when challenges exceed Tier 2 or internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner, delivering advanced Microsoft 365, cloud, and security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.

Our engineers are trusted technical partners — leading implementations, resolving complex escalations, and working directly with MSP clients to execute real-world solutions.

________________________________________

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior-level Cloud Solutions Engineer (Level 3) to lead advanced Microsoft 365 and cloud initiatives, handle complex escalations, and implement solutions directly with MSP clients. This is a technical, customer-facing role — while not sales-focused, you will regularly work directly with customers to design and implement the solutions required to meet their business and technical needs.

This role requires strong technical depth, independence, and the ability to step into unfamiliar environments and software ecosystems with confidence.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Cloud & Escalation Support

• Handle advanced and expert-level escalations related to cloud infrastructure and SaaS services.

• Serve as a senior escalation point for Microsoft 365 and cloud-related issues across multiple MSP environments.

• Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term remediation for complex or recurring issues.

• Work directly with MSP clients and end customers to execute solutions and improvements.



Microsoft 365 (Core Focus Area)

• Architect, deploy, optimize, and support Microsoft 365 environments end-to-end, including:

o Exchange Online (mail flow, security, migrations, troubleshooting)

o SharePoint Online and OneDrive (architecture, permissions, governance, performance, migrations)

o Microsoft Teams (policies, governance, troubleshooting)

• Perform and lead tenant-to-tenant migrations, including
, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Teams data.

• Execute server-to-cloud migrations, such as file servers to SharePoint or OneDrive.

• Expert-level administration and troubleshooting of:

o Microsoft Intune (endpoint management, compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, Autopilot)

o Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) including identity lifecycle, SSO, MFA, and hybrid identity

o Conditional Access policy design and enforcement

o Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Office 365, Identity)

o Microsoft Purview (data governance, retention, compliance, DLP)

• Implement and maintain Microsoft 365 security best practices across client tenants.

• Assist MSPs with tenant configuration, licensing strategy, and feature utilization.



Third-Party Application Integration

• Work with third-party software applications that integrate with Microsoft 365 
, identity, security, document management, line-of-business platforms).

• Support applications you may not have prior experience with, requiring:

o Willingness to learn new platforms quickly

o Ability to understand how third-party systems interact with Microsoft 365

o Troubleshooting authentication, permissions, data flow, and integration issues

• Collaborate with vendors and MSPs to ensure proper configuration and supportability.



Server and Infrastructure Support

• Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and File Services.

• Manage and support virtualization platforms (e.g., Hyper-V, VMware) in on-premises and hybrid configurations.

• Perform server migrations, including lift-and-shift to Azure, P2V conversions, and workload transitions to cloud-hosted services.

• Support and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions, ensuring recoverability for both on-premises and cloud workloads.

• Assist with decommissioning legacy on-premises infrastructure as part of cloud migration projects.



Projects, Optimization & Automation

• Lead cloud migration and optimization projects for MSP clients.

• Optimize Microsoft 365 environments for security, performance, and cost efficiency.

• Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to automate Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and related administrative tasks.

• Recommend improvements, standards, and long-term strategies to MSP partners.

• Stay current on Microsoft 365 feature changes and emerging cloud technologies.

Availability & Support Expectations

• Standard working hours are 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST.

• Some flexibility is required for high-impact client issues, critical changes, or migrations outside normal hours.

• This role is not on-call, but responsiveness during critical events is expected.

________________________________________

Qualifications

Required Experience

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud solutions in an MSP or multi-tenant environment.

• Expert-level proficiency in:

o Microsoft 365 (all major workloads and admin portals)

o Microsoft Intune

o Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)

o Conditional Access and MFA

o Microsoft Defender and Purview

• Strong experience with:

o Tenant-to-tenant Microsoft 365 migrations

o Server-to-cloud migrations (e.g., file servers to SharePoint/OneDrive)

o
 and data migrations

• Required experience with PowerShell for administration and automation.

• Experience with Google Workspace and cross-platform migrations.

• Expert-level understanding of SaaS security and cloud cost optimization.

• General knowledge of infrastructure and networking concepts.

• Proven experience working in MSP environments (required).

• Excellent native-level English communication skills, both written and verbal.

title: Tier 2 Helpdesk Technician
description:
Position Summary



We are a small managed service provider (MSP) looking for a Helpdesk Technician who can own the full support lifecycle — from first-contact triage through advanced troubleshooting — across our client base. You’ll be the primary point of contact for end users, handling everything from password resets and printer issues to Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace administration, network diagnostics, and server-level troubleshooting. Because we’re a small team, you’ll wear many hats, work directly with clients, and have real impact on how we deliver service.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities



Front-Line Support



• Answer incoming calls,
s, and tickets; log all requests accurately in the PSA/ticketing system (Superops)

• Perform initial triage — gather symptoms, identify urgency, and resolve straightforward issues on first contact when possible

• Handle common requests: password resets, MFA setup, account unlocks, new-user onboarding/offboarding,
 and calendar issues, printer troubleshooting, and basic software installs

• Walk end users through solutions clearly and patiently, adapting communication style to non-technical audiences

Advanced Troubleshooting

• Troubleshoot complex workstation, laptop, and peripheral issues across Windows 10/11 and macOS environments

• Administer and maintain Active Directory, Azure AD / Entra ID, Microsoft 365 tenants, and Group Policy across multiple client environments

• Diagnose network connectivity problems including DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall rules, and switching/routing basics
