title: Podcast Video Editor – Paid Trial With Ongoing Work Potential
description:
I’m looking for a creative video editor to complete a small paid trial for a long-form spiritual podcast. If the work is a good fit, this may become recurring work for future podcast episodes and YouTube content.



For this first project, I will provide:



* The full podcast video

* Separate audio files for the host and guest

* A brief description of the episode and guest



Your primary task is to review the conversation, identify one of its most interesting or compelling moments, and turn it into a professionally edited 60–90 second intro for the beginning of the episode.



The intro should:



* Immediately create curiosity and make viewers want to continue watching

* Use the strongest statements from the guest

* Build naturally instead of feeling like disconnected clips

* Include tasteful, relevant B-roll that supports what the guest is saying

* Preserve the guest’s original meaning and avoid misleading clickbait

* Transition smoothly into the normal beginning of the podcast



There are also portions of the recording where the host’s video and audio are slightly out of sync. The spoken audio sometimes occurs before the host’s mouth movements. Please correct this synchronization issue wherever it appears.



This is a conversational long-form podcast, so I do not want excessive cuts, constant zooming, flashy effects, or heavy editing. The final style should feel polished, thoughtful, cinematic, and natural.



This initial trial is limited to two paid hours. Focus first on creating the 60–90 second intro and correcting the audio/video synchronization. Do not spend time heavily editing the entire episode.



To apply, please include:



1. One or two examples of podcast, interview, documentary, or talking-head videos you have edited

2. The editing software you use

3. Confirmation that you can work with separate video and audio files

4. Your availability to begin

5. The word “SUN” at the beginning of your application so I know you read the full description



Editors who understand storytelling and can recognize an engaging moment—not merely perform technical cuts—will be given priority.



Pay negotiable for the actual gig. The trial wage is non - negotiable as we are working with many contractors during this period. Over time hours will likely increase for the actual gig.

This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Construction Estimator
description:
# Construction Estimator – Residential & Commercial



**Location:** Philippines – Remote

**Employment:** Part-Time – 20 hours per week initially

**Opportunity:** Full-Time position available following successful trial period



## About the Role



We are an Australian construction company seeking an experienced **Construction Estimator** to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



The role will initially be **20 hours per week on a trial basis**, with the opportunity to progress to a full-time ongoing position for the right candidate.



You will assist with estimating and procurement across residential and commercial construction projects, working closely with our Australian-based team.



## Key Responsibilities



* Review and accurately interpret architectural, structural, engineering and other construction documentation.

* Complete detailed **quantity take-offs** for labour, materials and subcontract works.

* Prepare detailed construction estimates and cost breakdowns.

* Prepare clear, trade-specific **Scopes of Work**.

* Prepare and issue **Requests for Quotation (RFQs)** to subcontractors and suppliers.

* Review and compare quotations, identifying exclusions, discrepancies and cost differences.

* Create, maintain and populate detailed **estimating spreadsheets** with quantities, rates, quotations and allowances.

* Update estimates as drawings, pricing and project requirements change.

* Identify missing, conflicting or unclear information within construction documentation.

* Maintain accurate and organised estimating documentation within **Google Drive**.

* Maintain document naming, filing and version control.

* Assist with improving our estimating templates, processes and systems.



## Required Experience & Skills



* Previous experience as a **Construction Estimator, Quantity Surveyor, Cost Estimator or similar role**.

* Strong ability to read and understand construction drawings and specifications.

* Demonstrated experience completing accurate quantity take-offs.

* Experience preparing estimates, cost plans and scopes of work.

* Experience obtaining and comparing subcontractor and supplier quotations.

* Strong **Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel** skills.

* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

* Good organisational and document-control skills.

* Good written and spoken English.

* Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.



## Highly Regarded



Experience with the following will be highly regarded:



* Both **residential and commercial construction**.

* Australian construction companies or Australian projects.

* Australian construction terminology, trades and building practices.

* Construction estimating or quantity take-off software.

* Subcontractor tender comparisons and procurement.

* Australian construction drawings and documentation standards.



## What We're Looking For



Accuracy is extremely important.



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply measure drawings and enter quantities into a spreadsheet. You should be able to **understand how a project is constructed, recognise missing or conflicting information and develop a complete and logical estimate**.



You should be organised, proactive, accountable for your work and comfortable asking questions when information is unclear.



## Hours & Opportunity



* **20 hours per week initially**

* Remote position based in the Philippines

* Initial trial period

* Opportunity to progress to a **full-time ongoing position** based on performance



## How to Apply



Please provide:



* Your CV / resume.

* A brief summary of your construction estimating experience.

* Details of residential and/or commercial projects you have estimated.

* Any experience working on Australian construction projects.

* Estimating and quantity take-off software you are experienced with.

* Your current availability.

* Your expected monthly or hourly rate.



**Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical estimating test using a sample set of construction drawings.**

title: Executive Assistant for a Founder with ADHD (Wellness / Spa Business)
description:
ABOUT US



We run two float therapy and wellness spas in Utah (True REST Float Spa, Draper and Provo). Float tanks, infrared sauna, cold plunge, red light. We are building a business that runs day to day on a small remote team plus in-spa staff, so the owner can work on growth instead of daily operations. You would join a small, close-knit team and work directly with the owner.



ABOUT THE ROLE (please read this carefully)



I am the owner, and I am a founder with ADHD. I am strong at vision, strategy, and building new systems. I am weak at follow-through, time management, and staying organized. My pattern is that I build something, then drift off it, and it falls apart because I am the only one holding it together.



I am not looking for someone who waits for instructions. I am looking for a right hand who keeps me on track, owns the list of what matters, chases me for what they need, and keeps moving even when I go quiet. In this role, not chasing me is underperforming. If you quietly wait for the boss to reply, this is not the role for you. If you bring order to a scattered founder and make sure nothing falls through the cracks, keep reading.



This is a part-time role, around 20 to 25 hours per week, but it is not an async role. I need daily overlap with US Mountain Time so we work in close to real time.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- My priority and task list. You keep it current and keep me accountable to it.

- My daily and weekly cadence. You check in, chase me for decisions and inputs, and follow up until things close. You do not wait to be asked.

- A weekly summary: what moved, what stalled, what needs my input, and the next priorities.

- Inbox and calendar. Scheduling, reminders, prep for what is coming up.

- Turning my half-formed ideas into clear plans, steps, and owners.

- Coordinating with the rest of the team and our contractors so I am not the go-between for everything.

- Catching the small things before they become big problems.



MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



- Prior experience as an executive assistant, chief of staff, or operations support to a business owner or executive, ideally a big-picture or scattered type.

- A track record of building simple processes and bringing order to chaos.

- Strong prioritization. You can look at a messy pile and d
 what matters right now.

- Comfortable with ambiguity. You can take a vague ask and turn it into a plan without hand-holding.

- Proactive communicator. You chase, follow up, and close loops.

- Excellent written English.

- Reliable daily overlap with US Mountain Time.



BONUS (call these out if you have them)



- Experience supporting a founder or executive with ADHD or similar executive-function challenges. This is the single most relevant thing you can have, so tell me about it.

- Experience in a wellness, spa, fitness, health, or appointment-based service business.

- Familiarity with Slack, Google Workspace, and booking or POS software like Boulevard.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Use "EA for Float Spa" as your subject line, and start your message with the word RESET. Both prove you read this post all the way through. Applications missing either will not be reviewed.

2. Apply with at least 15 Apply Points. Applications below that will not be reviewed.

3. Answer these four questions briefly:

   - Tell me about a business owner or executive you supported who struggled with follow-through or staying organized. What specifically did you do to keep them and their priorities on track?

   - It is your first week, and I am vague about what I need from you. Walk me through what you do.

   - When everything feels urgent at once, how do you d
 what is most important?

   - Do you have experience in wellness, spa, health, or service businesses? If so, tell me about it.

4. Share a short note on your availability and your daily overlap with US Mountain Time.

title: Short-Form Gaming Content Creator / Video Editor – Plix.gg
description:
Plix.gg is a browser games portal with 72,000+ games and 180K+ monthly

visitors. We're hiring one person to own our short-form video output

end to end: find the games, record them, write the hooks, cut the

videos, post them.



This is NOT an editing-only role. We do not send you footage. If you

only want to edit clips someone else planned, this isn't your job.



Look at CrazyGames on TikTok or similar gaming ones.



WHAT YOU DO

- Dig through our catalogue and find games worth a video

- Record gameplay yourself (clean screen capture, 1080x1920)

- Write your own hooks and concepts — you are the ideas person

- Edit 10-40 second videos: fast cuts, music, captions, sound design

- Test alternative opening hooks and tell us what worked



Anything that works goes: gameplay, memes, challenges, reactions,

listicles, POV. We don't have a template and we don't want one.





OUTPUT

15 finished videos per week.

Each one gets posted to TikTok, Reels and Shorts.

5 videos per week ship with a second opening hook for A/B testing.



We measure retention and views, not file count. Tell us when a concept

is weak instead of shipping it to hit a number.





HOURS

We don't care when you work. No fixed schedule, no timezone overlap,

no clocking in. Everything is scheduled in advance, so nobody needs

to be awake at upload time.





VOICE AND AI

You do not need to appear on camera or use your own voice (but you are open to do so).

- AI voiceover: allowed and encouraged

- AI captions and script assistance: fine

- AI-generated B-roll, stock slideshows, or the same template repeated

  across dozens of uploads: not allowed





SETUP YOU NEED

- A PC that runs browser games smoothly and records at 1080p

- CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve — your choice, we don't care

- You'll deliver project files alongside exports





REQUIREMENTS

- Strong short-form editing, with work to show

- You genuinely understand hooks and first-3-second retention

- You play games and can tell when one is actually interesting

- You can work independently. We give feedback weekly, not hourly.





PAY

$900/month (approx 55,000 PHP), paid monthly via Wise.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with PLIX. Applications without it get deleted.



Send:



1. 3-5 short-form videos you edited. Say exactly what you did on each

   — did you shoot it, write it, or just cut it?



2. Your editing software



3. THREE video ideas for Plix.gg. Each one must name a specific game

   with its plix.gg URL, plus the exact opening line you would say.

   This is the part we actually judge you on.



4. How do you keep someone watching past the first 3 seconds? Be

   specific, how you pick and cut to music, what you do with

   transitions, zooms, sound effects, text timing. Don't list

   buzzwords, tell us what you actually do.



5. Your PC specs and internet speed



Shortlisted applicants get a paid trial video: 1,000 PHP, paid whether

or not we hire you. We run several trials at the same time.

title: Sales & Patient Acquisition Lead — $1,000+/month Potential (US Hours)
description:
PLEASE READ FIRST — do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

Applications sent through this site are not reviewed. To be considered, you must apply through our own form here: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a

It takes about 10 minutes and includes a short voice recording.



Hi, I'm Dr. Abrar Al-Shaer, PhD, RD, LDN: a registered dietitian nutritionist and herbalist in the United States. I run Precision Women's Care, an integrative practice where we help women get to the root of their health issues — PCOS, fertility, hormones, gut health, perimenopause — and feel like themselves again.



We're a small, close team, fully remote, and we care a great deal about the women who come to us.



Women find us, reach out, and genuinely want help — and then some of them quietly slip away because nobody followed up well enough. I'm looking for someone to own our front door: the leads, the phone, the follow-up, and the conversation that turns an interested woman into a patient.



This is a sales role, and it's also the first voice a woman hears from our practice. Both have to be true at once.



About the pay, before anything else. Your base is $7/hour, but this role is built so your income follows your results, not the clock. You earn a bonus on every patient and member you bring in, so $1,000+ a month is well within reach if you convert well. Do this properly and you should out-earn the hourly rate comfortably.



What you'll do

- Follow up quickly with every woman who reaches out, and guide her toward booking

- Have the real conversation: what we offer, what it costs, and what's holding her back

- Turn interested women into patients and members

- Keep following up with the ones who say "let me think about it" — this is where most of the value lives

- Answer and return calls on our practice phone during US hours

- Schedule patient follow-ups and make sure nothing sits unanswered



Who I'm looking for



Near-native English comes first, and it isn't negotiable. You'll be on the phone with American women talking about deeply personal things. You need to sound warm, natural, and completely at ease — able to hear hesitation in someone's voice and respond to it. Not scripted. Not stiff.



- You've actually sold something and closed it. Health, wellness, coaching, or memberships is a real plus

- You're comfortable with money. You can say a price out loud and then stay quiet

- You're warm, not pushy. Hard-closing will damage the trust our patients place in us

- You run yourself. You'll own the follow-up. Nobody will chase you

- You can work a consistent 4-hour block each weekday, on US Eastern time

- This role is open to women only. Our patients are women discussing fertility and hormones, and they've told us plainly that they're more comfortable speaking with another woman



The details

- Pay: $7/hour base, plus a bonus on every patient and member you bring in. A strong month lands around $1,000+ per month

- Hours: 20 per week to start — the same 4-hour block each weekday, US Eastern

- Growth: 4-week paid fellowship ? 3 months part-time ? full-time based on performance

- We provide: our practice phone system, Notion, and Toggl



How to apply

1. Application and voice recording: 
tion.site/3b70d95da57c80ec9e3ff25ac24cd60a.

2. Interview. A real conversation, with some role-play.

3. Fellowship. A paid 4 weeks working alongside us. That's how we both find out if this is right.



If you're wonderful on the phone and you want your work to genuinely change how a woman feels in her own body, I'd love to hear from you.



— Abrar

title: Student Body Doubling & Study Hall Coach
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Type: Independent Contractor/Full-Time

Reports To: Head Counselors/Principal





About the Company

Telos is the ancient Greek word for "greater purpose" — the idea at the core of how we work with students. Telos Prep is a purpose-driven college counseling company that helps students connect what they love, what they're good at, and how they can help others, rather than chasing a résumé-driven checklist. We take a team-based, high-touch approach: each student gets a Head Counselor for biweekly strategy meetings, plus access to a full team of specialists across research, essays, STEM, and creative mentorship, with AI tools supporting (not replacing) that relationship. 





About the Role

Telos Prep is looking for a reliable, encouraging person to lead virtual study halls and provide body-doubling support for our students.

Body doubling means helping students stay focused simply by being present, creating structure, and providing calm accountability while they work. This has been highly effective for our students, and we're expanding the amount of support we offer.

This is not a traditional tutoring role. You will not be expected to teach every subject or complete students' work. Your primary responsibility is to create a focused, welcoming environment where students can make steady progress.

We're especially interested in candidates who have tutored before or have experience supporting students who need extra academic structure, patience, and encouragement.





Responsibilities

- Host and facilitate virtual student study halls

- Maintain a calm, focused, and positive online environment

- Help students set goals and identify what they plan to accomplish

- Check in with students throughout the session

- Encourage students to return to task when they become distracted

- Notice patterns or concerns and communicate them to the appropriate Telos team member

- Track attendance and basic participation notes

- Follow Telos policies for student privacy, communication, and escalation

- Help make study hall feel structured, supportive, and consistent





Schedule & Work Environment

- Hours: Sunday–Thursday, 2:00–10:00 PM Pacific Time, full-time availability required.

- Time zone note: This window falls roughly 5:00 AM–1:00 PM Philippine Time, so a routine that keeps you alert and engaged during those hours is important.

- Flexibility: Occasional schedule adjustments may be needed for student programming.

- Fully Remote: This role is 100% remote, allowing you to work from home.

- Tech Setup: A stable internet connection, a working webcam, and a clear microphone are required, since sessions are run live over video with students.

- Workspace: A quiet, well-lit space free of distractions helps you stay present and attentive with students throughout each session.





What You'll Need

- Dependable and consistently available during scheduled hours

- Patient, encouraging, and comfortable working with students

- Strong communication and follow-through

- Able to stay attentive and engaged during long virtual sessions

- Comfortable using video calls, chat, calendars, and basic productivity tools

- Able to set boundaries while remaining warm and supportive

- Prior experience in education, mentoring, coaching, counseling support, childcare, or student services is helpful but not required





Preferred Experience

- Prior experience tutoring, mentoring, or supporting students academically

- Experience working with students who need additional academic support, including students who have struggled in traditional classroom settings

- Experience with remedial education, learning differences, executive-function challenges, or individualized student support is a strong plus





Successful Candidates Will Be

- Calm and steady

- Organized and punctual

- Naturally encouraging without being overbearing

- Comfortable working independently

- Genuinely interested in helping students build strong work habits





Compensation

- Pay: $800 per month

- Resources: Telos will provide the necessary software subscriptions and tools required for the role (e.g. Google Workspace account).





Holidays & Time Off

- Philippine Holidays: The Contractor is entitled to paid time off for all regular Philippine holidays included in the company's officially provided vacation and PTO policy. These holidays are observed in PHT and include:

    - January 1: New Year's Day

    - April 2: Maundy Thursday

    - April 3: Good Friday

    - April 9: Araw ng Kagitingan (Day of Valor)

    - May 1: Labor Day

    - June 12: Independence Day

    - August 31: National Heroes Day

    - November 30: Bonifacio Day

title: UK Payroll Specialist / Payroll Manager
description:
Remote | Philippines | UK Accountancy Practice



About Us



We are a growing UK accountancy practice supporting a wide range of small and medium-sized businesses.



We are building a fantastic team in the Philippines and are now looking for an experienced UK Payroll Specialist to take ownership of payroll across our practice.



This is not a basic payroll processing or data-entry role.



We need somebody who understands UK payroll properly, can work independently, spot problems, communicate confidently with clients and become the person our wider team relies on for payroll.



The Role



You will be responsible for managing weekly and monthly payrolls for multiple UK clients from start to finish.



Your responsibilities will include:



Processing weekly and monthly UK payrolls

Managing multiple client payroll deadlines

Calculating PAYE and National Insurance

Processing starters and leavers

Handling P45s and other payroll documentation

Managing statutory payments such as SSP, SMP, SPP and SAP

Processing directors' payrolls

Dealing with irregular payments, corrections and payroll adjustments

Managing workplace pensions and auto-enrolment

Preparing and submitting FPS and EPS reports to HMRC

Dealing with payroll year-end procedures

Responding directly to client payroll queries

Reviewing payroll information and identifying anything that doesn't look right

Keeping accurate payroll records

Supporting our accountants and client managers with payroll-related queries

Helping us improve and document our payroll processes

Who We're Looking For



You must already have good practical experience of UK payroll.



Ideally, you will have worked for a UK accountancy practice, payroll bureau or outsourcing company where you have managed payroll for multiple clients.



We are looking for somebody who:



Has strong UK payroll knowledge

Understands PAYE, National Insurance and RTI

Understands UK workplace pensions and auto-enrolment

Has experience managing multiple client payrolls

Can confidently deal with payroll corrections and more complicated situations

Is comfortable communicating directly with UK clients

Has excellent attention to detail

Can manage deadlines without needing to be constantly chased

Takes ownership of their work

Is confident asking questions when something doesn't look right

Enjoys solving problems rather than simply following instructions



Experience using Moneysoft Payroll Manager would be a big advantage, although we are happy to train the right person on the software if your UK payroll knowledge is strong.



Experience working with UK accountants or bookkeepers would also be highly desirable.



This Role Would Suit Someone Who...



Likes being trusted with responsibility.



You don't want somebody checking every single thing you do forever. You want to understand the role properly, take ownership of it and become excellent at it.



You enjoy being the person who knows what is going on.



You notice when something doesn't make sense and investigate it.



You care about getting things right.



And you are looking for a long-term position where you can become an important part of a growing team.



Working With Us



We are a friendly, down-to-earth UK accountancy practice and we genuinely value our team.



We already work with team members in the Philippines and are continuing to build our Philippines-based team.



We care far more about the quality of your work, communication and reliability than somebody simply appearing online for a certain number of hours.



You will be supported by our UK team, but the aim is for you to eventually take real ownership of the payroll function, rather than simply wait for tasks to be assigned to you.



This is intended to be a long-term role for the right person.



Hours



Please tell us:



How many hours per week you are available

Your preferred working hours

How much overlap you can provide with UK working hours

Whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers



We are open to discussing the working pattern with the right candidate.



Salary



Please include your expected hourly or monthly salary in PHP when applying.



We are looking for the right person rather than simply the cheapest applicant, so please base your expected rate on your experience and ability.



How to Apply



Please send us:



A brief introduction explaining why you think you would be a good fit for the role.

Details of your UK payroll experience, including approximately how many payrolls you have managed.

Details of any experience working for a UK accountancy practice or payroll bureau.

The payroll software you have used.

Your experience with PAYE, National Insurance, RTI, pensions and statutory payments.

Your expected hourly or monthly rate in PHP.

Your availability and preferred working hours.

Your CV.



Please also start your application with the words "UK PAYROLL" so we know you have read the full advert.



We are particularly interested in hearing from people who are seeking a long-term role and would like to become a valued part of our team, rather than simply completing individual outsourced tasks.

title: Recruitment & Human Resources Coordinator
description:
**Recruitment & Human Resources Coordinator



 **24/7 HomeCare Solutions**

 *Enhancing Lives 24/7*



**Location:** Remote

**Employment Type:** Part-Time with Potential for Full-Time as Agency Grows

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

**On-Call:** As Assigned / Shared Leadership Coverage

**Compensation:** Starting at **$5.00 USD/hour**, with performance-based increases up to **$8.00 USD/hour**



## **Position Overview**



24/7 HomeCare Solutions is seeking an organized, proactive, flexible, and highly communicative **Recruitment & Human Resources Coordinator** to manage caregiver recruitment, hiring, onboarding, employee compliance, training management, employee census management, and ongoing HR administration.



This position is responsible for maintaining an active caregiver pipeline and ensuring qualified candidates move efficiently from application through interview, hiring, onboarding, training, compliance clearance, and final handoff for orientation.



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator serves as the **primary HR point of contact** for applicants, new hires, and employees regarding HR-related matters.



The ideal candidate is a **team player who is flexible, solution-oriented, and willing to assist with phones, communications, and general agency operations while maintaining ownership of their primary HR and recruitment responsibilities.**



This is not a position for someone who waits to be told what to do. We are looking for someone who follows up consistently, communicates proactively, maintains accurate records, meets deadlines, identifies problems, and takes ownership of responsibilities without requiring constant reminders.



**This position is intended to become a long-term leadership support role. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our agency and take ownership of their responsibilities without requiring ongoing daily supervision.**



# **Primary Responsibilities**



## **Recruitment**



* Maintain an active caregiver recruitment pipeline.

* Create, post, monitor, and update job advertisements.

* Monitor job boards and applicant sources daily.

* Review incoming applications.

* Screen candidates for minimum qualifications.

* Contact qualified applicants promptly.

* Conduct initial telephone/video screenings.

* Schedule and conduct caregiver interviews as assigned.

* Maintain accurate interview notes.

* Follow up with qualified candidates after interviews.

* Communicate hiring decisions promptly.

* Maintain an accurate recruitment tracker showing each applicant's current status.

* Re-engage qualified previous applicants when staffing needs arise.

* Maintain a pool of PRN and backup caregivers.

* Recruit proactively based on upcoming client and staffing needs rather than waiting until shifts become open.

* Communicate recruiting challenges and staffing shortages to leadership.



## **Hiring & Pre-Employment**



For candidates selected for hire:



* Send employment offers and required onboarding documents.

* Collect required identification and employment documentation.

* Initiate required background and exclusion screenings.

* Complete OIG and other required exclusion checks.

* Verify required licenses, certifications, and credentials when applicable.

* Verify CPR/First Aid requirements when applicable.

* Verify TB, physical, driver's license, automobile insurance, and other required documentation based on position requirements.

* Complete reference checks when required.

* Maintain documentation of completed screenings.

* Follow up with candidates regarding missing requirements.

* Ensure pre-employment requirements are completed timely.

* Do not release employees for orientation until required HR onboarding requirements have been satisfied.



## **Employee Onboarding**



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator owns the **HR portion of the onboarding process**.



Responsibilities include:



* Send new-hire onboarding packets.

* Ensure required forms are completed accurately.

* Review onboarding documents for missing information or signatures.

* Maintain the new-hire onboarding tracker.

* Create and maintain employee HR records.

* Add new employees to **Paychex**.

* Assign required new-hire training.

* Track training completion.

* Follow up with employees regarding incomplete onboarding requirements.

* Communicate onboarding status to management.

* Ensure employees meet required HR and compliance requirements before orientation.

* Complete a formal handoff to the Care & Engagement Lead once HR onboarding requirements are satisfied.



# **Training Management**



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator is responsible for **tracking and managing required employee training**.



Responsibilities include:



* Assign required training to new and existing employees.

* Track and manage completion of required training.

* Maintain accurate training records.

* Monitor training deadlines and expiration dates.

* Follow up with employees regarding incomplete or overdue training.

* Track new-hire, annual, recurring, remedial, and position-specific training requirements.

* Ensure required pre-orientation training is completed before an employee is released for orientation when applicable.

* Maintain training documentation within employee personnel files and applicable agency systems.

* Update onboarding and compliance trackers with current training status.

* Notify employees proactively regarding upcoming training requirements.

* Escalate overdue or non-compliant training to management.

* Coordinate with the Care & Engagement Lead regarding employees who have completed HR requirements and are ready for orientation.

* Work with the Operations Quality Assurance Coordinator (Compliance) to correct training deficiencies identified during audits.

* Maintain training records in an organized and audit/survey-ready condition.



# **Employee Census Management**



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator is responsible for maintaining the agency's **master employee census as a live and accurate operational record**.



Responsibilities include:



* Maintain and update the master employee census.

* Add newly hired employees to the census.

* Maintain accurate employee contact information.

* Track employee position, department, location/market, employment type, hire date, and current status.

* Maintain appropriate statuses, including applicant, pending hire, onboarding, orientation pending, active, PRN, leave of absence, inactive, compliance hold, suspended, and terminated.

* Update the census promptly whenever an employee's status changes.

* Track orientation completion and date cleared to begin working.

* Track employee training and compliance status.

* Monitor employees who have not worked recently and flag potentially inactive employees for management review.

* Reconcile the employee census against **Paychex, CareSmartz360, Axxess/Axxess Care, HR trackers, and other applicable agency systems**.

* Identify discrepancies between systems and ensure corrections are completed.

* Communicate employee status changes to appropriate departments.

* Coordinate with the Care & Engagement Lead regarding caregivers who are active, available, inactive, or ready for assignment.

* Coordinate with the Operations Quality Assurance Coordinator (Compliance) regarding employees with outstanding compliance requirements.

* Ensure inactive and terminated employees are properly identified so system access and scheduling eligibility can be reviewed by the appropriate department.

* Maintain documentation supporting employee status changes.

* Provide leadership with accurate employee headcount information.

* Prepare weekly and monthly employee census reports.



Leadership should be able to request an employee census at any time and receive an accurate snapshot of:



**Total Employees | Active | PRN | Onboarding | Orientation Pending | Available for Assignment | Compliance Hold | Leave | Inactive | Suspended | Terminated**



**The employee census must be updated as changes occur—not only at payroll or month-end.**



# **HR Compliance**



* Maintain organized electronic personnel files.

* Maintain employee compliance trackers.

* Monitor credential and document expiration dates.

* Contact employees regarding upcoming expirations.

* Collect updated credentials and documentation.

* Upload and properly file updated documentation.

* Ensure employee records remain organized and audit-ready.

* Follow up with employees regarding missing compliance requirements.

* Work with the Operations Quality Assurance Coordinator (Compliance) to correct deficiencies identified during audits.

* Follow assigned compliance deficiencies through resolution.

* Maintain confidentiality of all employee information.



# **Paychex Administration**



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator serves as the primary HR owner of Paychex employee administration.



Responsibilities include:



* Add new employees to Paychex.

* Verify employee demographic information.

* Maintain employment-status information.

* Ensure required employee documentation is completed.

* Update employee information when changes occur.

* Process employee-status changes as directed.

* Maintain accurate HR records within Paychex.

* Coordinate with the payroll/operations team when employee changes affect payroll.



**Payroll calculation and payroll processing are not the primary responsibility of this position.**



# **Employee Relations & HR Communication**



* Monitor and respond to the agency HR
.

* Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee HR questions.

* Respond to applicants and employees professionally and promptly.

* Document significant employee concerns.

* Communicate attendance, conduct, or policy concerns to management.

* Assist leadership with corrective-action documentation when assigned.

* Maintain documentation of employee counseling, warnings, and HR communications as directed.

* Support employee offboarding and termination documentation as assigned.

* Update applicable systems and the employee census following status changes.

* Maintain professional boundaries and confidentiality.



# **Teamwork, Flexibility & Phone Coverage**



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator is expected to be a **team player** who understands that successful home care operations require flexibility, communication, and shared responsibility.



While recruitment, HR, onboarding, training, compliance, and employee census management remain the primary responsibilities of this position, the Coordinator is also expected to support general agency operations as needed.



Responsibilities include:



* **Answer and manage incoming agency phone calls throughout the workday.**

* Provide professional and courteous service to applicants, caregivers, clients, families, referral sources, and other callers.

* Take accurate messages and route calls to the appropriate team member.

* Respond promptly to HR-related calls,
s, voi
s, and messages.

* Assist with monitoring shared agency communications when assigned.

* Help ensure phones and messages remain covered when other team members are unavailable.

* Assist applicants and employees with routine questions within the scope of the position.

* Escalate urgent staffing, client, employee, compliance, payroll, billing, or clinical concerns to the appropriate team member.

* Assist with reasonable administrative and operational tasks during available time.

* Collaborate with the Care & Engagement Lead, Operations Quality Assurance Coordinator, Operations/Administrative team, and agency leadership.

* Communicate proactively rather than allowing an issue to remain unresolved simply because another department ultimately owns the issue.

* Remain flexible when agency priorities change or urgent operational needs arise.

* Assist with team coverage during employee absences, high-volume periods, and other operational needs within the scope of the position.

* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, flexibility, and a **team-first approach**.



# **Department Handoff**



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator owns the employee process from:



**RECRUIT ? SCREEN ? INTERVIEW ? HIRE ? ONBOARD ? TRAINING ? HR COMPLIANCE ? CENSUS UPDATE ? HANDOFF**



Once the employee has completed required HR onboarding, documentation, screenings, training, and compliance requirements, the Recruitment & HR Coordinator will notify the **Care & Engagement Lead** that the employee is ready for operational orientation, agency-system setup, scheduling, and client assignment.



The handoff must be documented in the agency's onboarding tracker and employee census.



# **Tracker & Documentation Management**



The Recruitment & HR Coordinator is responsible for ensuring recruitment, onboarding, compliance, training, and employee census trackers remain **accurate and current at all times**.



Records should clearly reflect:



* Applicant status

* Screening status

* Interview status

* Hiring decision

* Offer status

* Background/exclusion screening status

* Credential status

* Paychex status

* Training status

* Missing documents

* Compliance status

* Orientation readiness

* Handoff date

* Current employee status



**If an activity or employee-status change has occurred, the appropriate tracker and census should reflect it.**



# **Daily Expectations**



Each workday should include:



* Review new applicants.

* Contact qualified candidates.

* Conduct or schedule interviews.

* Follow up with candidates already in the hiring pipeline.

* Review new-hire onboarding progress.

* Follow up on missing documents.

* Review and manage outstanding employee training.

* Review recruitment and onboarding trackers.

* Update the employee census.

* Monitor HR
, calls, voi
s, and messages.

* Answer and assist with agency phone coverage.

* Review upcoming employee compliance expirations.

* Follow up on outstanding HR/compliance items.

* Communicate significant hiring, employee, or compliance concerns to leadership.



# **Weekly Reporting**



Provide leadership with a concise HR and recruitment report including:



* New applicants

* Candidates screened

* Interviews completed

* Offers extended

* New hires

* Employees currently onboarding

* Employees awaiting documentation

* Employees with outstanding training

* Employees ready for orientation

* Outstanding HR/compliance deficiencies

* Upcoming credential expirations

* Open positions and staffing needs

* Recruitment challenges requiring leadership attention

* Updated employee census summary

* HR issues requiring management follow-up



# **Qualifications**



### **Required / Strongly Preferred**



* Previous recruitment, HR, healthcare staffing, home care, or home health experience.

* Experience interviewing and screening candidates.

* Experience managing employee onboarding.

* Experience maintaining employee records and trackers.

* Strong written and verbal English communication.

* Professional and confident telephone communication.

* Excellent follow-up skills.

* Strong organization and attention to detail.

* Ability to manage multiple applicants and employees simultaneously.

* Ability to work independently.

* Flexible and willing to support overall agency operations.

* Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.

* Solution-oriented mindset.

* Ability to maintain confidential employee information.

* Comfortable following established policies and processes.

* Reliable internet connection and dedicated remote workspace.



### **Preferred Systems Experience**



* Paychex

* CareSmartz360

* Axxess / Axxess Care

* Zoho Recruit

* Zoho People

* Zoho One

* Google Workspace

* Indeed and other recruitment platforms

* Healthcare background/exclusion screening systems

* Employee training platforms



# **Performance Expectations & KPIs**



Success in this position includes:



* Applicants contacted promptly.

* Consistent caregiver recruitment pipeline.

* Interviews completed according to staffing needs.

* Recruitment/onboarding trackers maintained accurately.

* New hires followed through onboarding without unnecessary delays.

* **100% required HR compliance before release for orientation.**

* Required employee training assigned, tracked, completed timely, and accurately documented.

* **Employee census maintained accurately and updated as status changes occur.**

* Employee census reconciled with applicable agency systems.

* Paychex employee records maintained accurately.

* Credential and training expirations monitored proactively.

* HR
s and employee inquiries answered timely.

* Agency phones handled professionally and appropriately.

* Identified HR deficiencies corrected promptly.

* Strong follow-through without repeated reminders from management.

* Demonstrates flexibility, teamwork, professional communication, and willingness to support overall agency operations.

* Professional communication with applicants, caregivers, clients, employees, and leadership.



# **Growth Opportunity**



This position may begin as a **part-time role**, with the **potential to transition into full-time employment as the agency grows and recruitment and HR needs increase**.



As the agency's client census, staffing needs, service lines, and geographic footprint expand, this position may grow into a larger HR leadership role.



Team members who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, initiative, communication, leadership potential, flexibility, and independent ownership of the HR function may be considered for increased hours and advancement opportunities.



# **Compensation & Growth**



All new hires will complete a **60-day introductory/probationary period**.



During the **first 60 days**, compensation will be paid **monthly**. Upon successful completion of the 60-day introductory period, team members in good standing will transition to the agency's regular **biweekly payroll schedule**.



### **Days 1–30 — $5.00 USD/hour**



The first 30 days include structured onboarding, training, workflow development, and regular performance feedback.



### **30-Day Performance Review — Up to $6.00 USD/hour**



Team members demonstrating effective communication, strong organization, reliability, accountability, follow-through, accurate recordkeeping, flexibility, and increasing independence may be eligible for an increase to **$6.00 USD/hour**.



### **60-Day Performance Review — Up to $7.00 USD/hour**



Team members consistently performing the full scope of the position independently and meeting agency expectations may be eligible for an increase to **$7.00 USD/hour** and transition to the agency's **biweekly payroll schedule**.



### **Six-Month Performance Review — Up to $8.00 USD/hour**



Team members demonstrating sustained high performance, initiative, reliability, professionalism, excellent communication, teamwork, and complete ownership of recruitment and HR responsibilities may be eligible for an increase to **$8.00 USD/hour**.



**Compensation increases are performance-based and are not automatic.**



# **How to Apply**



Please
 your application to **both**:









### **Subject Line**



**Recruitment & HR Coordinator – [Your Name] – Enhancing Lives 24/7**



Please include your resume, a brief cover letter describing your recruitment/HR or healthcare experience, a **2–3 minute video introduction**, description of your recruiting and onboarding experience, list of HR/recruitment software used, three professional references, and available start date.



**To demonstrate attention to detail, include the phrase “Enhancing Lives 24/7” in your
 subject line. Applications that do not follow the application instructions may not be considered.**



**24/7 HomeCare Solutions**

*Enhancing Lives 24/7*

title: Creative Design Project Manager Specialist
description:
Role overview:

You are the operational backbone of a small creative studio. You own client communication, project flow, and quality control, and you execute design work directly when the primary designer is unavailable. The founder’s name is on every deliverable. Your job is to make sure nothing leaves the studio that the founder would not proudly sign.



Client Communication & Proactive Reporting

• Acknowledge every client request quickly with a clear, realistic timeline

• Send status updates on a set cadence (Mon/Wed/Fri minimum) without being asked

• When a client sends assets, materials, or information, notify the founder same day with what arrived, what it is for, and the deadline

• Update clients proactively when timelines shift, manage urgency without letting everything become urgent



Project Management

• Translate requests into fully scoped ClickUp tasks: complete instructions, correct files and Drive links, client history, due dates matching commitments

• Route work to the primary designer first, take on execution when they are at capacity

• Schedule against real capacity, flag conflicts early with proposed solutions

Design QA (Non-Negotiable)

• Every deliverable is verified before it ships: kerning, spacing, alignment, weight consistency, resolution, export quality, copy accuracy

• When modifying existing brand assets, work from and verify against the source file. Never repurpose an old asset as new work

• A 5-minute edit gets the same precision as a full project



Direct Design Execution

• The primary designer works async off-hours. When time-sensitive requests land, you execute them yourself to full professional standard: logo lockups, typography adjustments, layout corrections, production edits

• If a request exceeds your skill level, say so immediately and set expectations. Never attempt-and-ship



Admin & Organization

• Draft scopes of work from provided formulas, track approvals, send W-9s and documents

• Maintain clean Drive structure and naming conventions

Tools: ClickUp, Google Drive, Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Canva, 
. Working familiarity with Shopify, Webflow, WordPress, Squarespace, Wix.





Required skills

• Proven production design ability with a portfolio showing typography and logo lockup work

• Trained design eye, spots kerning and weight issues without being told

• Track record managing clients and projects for a small team or agency

• Proactive reporting habits, demonstrated, not claimed

• Honest self-assessment of skill limits

Nice-to-have: packaging or print design, experience supporting a creative founder or studio, retainer vs project familiarity

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
The Procurement Coordinator will be a key member of Imbibe’s Supply Chain & Operations team, primarily responsible for maintaining and improving the accuracy, integrity, and completeness of raw material data within Imbibe’s formulation system. This role will support cross-functional teams including Procurement, Research & Development (R&D), and Regulatory by ensuring that all approved raw materials are properly documented, validated, and up to date.



The Procurement Coordinator will lead data clean-up initiatives, standardize raw material records, and support regulatory compliance efforts through detailed documentation review. This role requires strong attention to detail, data management skills, and the ability to work collaboratively across functions to support efficient and compliant supply chain operations.



Essential Job Duties

• Maintain and improve raw material data accuracy within Imbibe’s formulation system, supporting ongoing data integrity initiatives

• Accurately enter and update raw material information within designated fields in the formulation database

• Standardize raw material descriptions in alignment with Imbibe’s naming conventions and data governance standards

• Cleanse existing raw material records by identifying and removing outdated or inaccurate information and replacing it with validated, current data

• Maintain and update pricing tiers and cost information for all approved raw materials in collaboration with Procurement

• Support regulatory compliance efforts by assisting in the review of approved raw materials for requirements including Prop 65, Non-GMO, Bioengineered (BE), and Country of Origin

• Review and validate regulatory documentation, including SDS, TDS, and Certificates of Origin, to ensure accuracy and completeness of raw material records

• Partner with Procurement, R&D, and Regulatory teams to ensure alignment and consistency across systems and documentation

• Identify opportunities to improve data management processes and recommend enhancements to increase efficiency and accuracy

• Support special projects and other supply chain initiatives as assigned



Minimum Qualifications

• 0–2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, data management, or a related role

• Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy in data entry and validation

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

• Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities



Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain management, food science, or a related field preferred

• Experience with formulation management systems

• Familiarity with regulatory documentation (SDS, TDS, COA, etc.)

• Experience working in the food and beverage or ingredients industry



Working Conditions

• Remote

title: Probate Paralegal
description:
Remote Probate Paralegal



Legacy Elder Law Center in Leesburg, Virginia is seeking an experienced, highly organized Remote Probate

Paralegal to join our team. This role is ideal for a paralegal with hands-on probate and estate

administration experience who can independently manage the day-to-day details of a probate

matter and provide exceptional service to clients navigating the loss of a loved one.



Position Overview

The Remote Probate Paralegal will work closely with our probate attorney, operations manager,

and clients throughout the probate and estate administration process. You will help move matters

forward by preparing documents, tracking deadlines, communicating with clients and third

parties, maintaining accurate files, and ensuring attorneys have the information they need at each

stage of administration.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, accountable, and comfortable

taking ownership of their caseload while working as part of a collaborative remote team.



Key Responsibilities

• Assist attorney with probate and estate administration matters from initial filing through

final distribution and closing.

• Prepare probate petitions, inventories, accountings, notices, correspondence, and other

court and estate administration documents for attorney review.

• Gather and organize information regarding estate assets, debts, beneficiaries, and

creditors.

• Communicate regularly and professionally with personal representatives, executors,

administrators, beneficiaries, financial institutions, courts, and other third parties.

• Coordinate the collection, valuation, transfer, and distribution of estate assets.

• Assist with obtaining date-of-death values and other financial information needed for

estate administration.

• Track court deadlines, filing requirements, creditor periods, inventories, accountings, and

other critical dates.

• Prepare and coordinate probate filings and monitor matters for court orders, notices, and

other developments.

• Maintain organized and accurate electronic client files.

• Follow up with clients and third parties regarding outstanding documents and

information.

• Keep attorney and operations manager informed of the status of matters, upcoming

deadlines, and issues requiring attorney attention.

• Assist with the preparation of estate accountings and distributions.

• Help ensure matters progress efficiently and do not stall because of missing information

or incomplete follow-up.

• Maintain strict confidentiality of client and firm information.• Follow established firm workflows, procedures, and quality-control standards.



Qualifications

• Prior probate or estate administration paralegal experience strongly preferred.

• Experience independently handling the administrative aspects of probate matters is highly

desirable.

• Familiarity with probate pleadings, inventories, accountings, creditor procedures, and

estate distributions.

• Excellent and clear (USA) written and verbal communication skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong organizational, calendaring, and deadline-management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active matters and competing priorities.

• Comfortable communicating directly with clients who may be experiencing grief or

difficult family circumstances.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly

responsive to attorneys and other team members.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning legal practice-management,

document-management, and cloud-based systems.

• Paralegal certificate or related education is a plus but may not be required depending on

experience.



The Right Person for This Role

The right candidate understands that excellent probate work requires more than preparing forms.

You should be someone who can look at a matter, understand what has been completed, what

needs to happen next, and who needs to be contacted to make it happen.

You follow through without needing repeated reminders. You catch missing information and

inconsistencies. You communicate clearly when a matter needs attorney involvement, and you

understand the importance of documenting your work.

Just as importantly, you understand that probate clients are often dealing with grief, family

dynamics, financial concerns, and an unfamiliar legal process. We expect our team to

combine efficiency and attention to detail with patience, professionalism, and compassion.



Position Details

• Position: Probate Paralegal – Independent Contractor

• Work Arrangement: Remote

• Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday 9AM to 5:30PM EST with 30 minute break.

• Compensation: Compensation is commensurate with experience

• Benefits: Paid US holidays and 1 (one) week paid vacation after 1 (one) year of full-time employment.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction describing your probate and estate

administration experience.

In your application, please tell us:

1. Approximately how many years of probate or estate administration experience you have.

2. Which aspects of a probate matter you have handled directly.

3. What case-management or legal software you have used.

4. Why you are interested in a remote probate paralegal position with Legacy Elder Law Center

5. Provide references

6. Please provide a brief voice recording when applying for this position, and include the word PROBATE in the subject line

title: AP / Expense Reconciliation Support
description:
About the role

TR Tax and Bookkeeping Services is hiring a part-time contractor for accounts payable reconciliation support. This is expense-side work only to start — no revenue, no bank rec sign-off, no client contact. You'll work inside QuickBooks Online (scoped access) and our contractor portal for task assignments.



This starts with 2-3 clients on AP/expense-side recon. As trust builds, both the client list and the scope of work can grow — this could develop into full reconciliation work over time.



What you'll actually do

Categorize and reconcile vendor bills and expense transactions against monthly statements

Match expense-side transactions in QBO

Flag discrepancies for review — you're doing the recon legwork, not making final calls on client books



Schedule

Work happens during the first 10 business days of each month — that's when most recon work lands. Statements come in staggered across clients, so tasks get assigned staggered too, not all at once. Occasionally a client runs late and work falls outside that window — it's the exception, not the norm.



No fixed hours, no clock-in requirement

Turnaround: 24–48 hours from when a task is assigned to when it's done

title: Construction Scheduler - Florida Residential Home Builder (Fully Remote)
description:
We are a residential home building company based in Southwest Florida. Our projects follow a consistent, well-established construction sequence, and we already use a proven schedule template in Buildertrend that repeats with each new home. We are looking for a sharp, proactive Construction Scheduler who can own the schedule process end-to-end and keep multiple homes moving efficiently.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Own and maintain live project schedules in Buildertrend for all active homes, updating them constantly based on field progress, photos, daily logs, and completion percentages.

2. Schedule and coordinate all trades, material deliveries, equipment, inspections, tests, surveys, and other critical-path activities using the established template.

3. Issue clear, timely notifications and confirmations to subcontractors, suppliers, inspectors, and internal team members so everyone knows exactly when they are expected on site.

4. Act as the central scheduling communication hub between office management, the construction manager, field supervisors, subcontractors, material suppliers, and inspectors.

5. Proactively flag potential delays (weather, material lead times, subcontractor delays, inspection backlogs/failed inspections, etc.) and work with the construction manager to develop recovery plans.

6. Track material lead times and delivery windows so materials arrive when needed without clogging the site or creating storage issues.

7. Document schedule changes, delays, and reasons accurately inside Buildertrend to support schedule and procedures improvement.

8. Continuously evolve and optimize the master schedule template by incorporating lessons learned from completed homes and adapting to changes in construction practices and inspection workflows, with the clear goal of maximizing efficiency and reducing overall construction time.

9. Support multi-project sequencing and resource leveling so trades and materials are not over-committed across the pipeline.

Follow up relentlessly on outstanding items that threaten the schedule (pending approvals, backordered materials, incomplete prior work, etc.).

10. Ensure scheduling continues to align with Southwest Florida permitting, inspection, and building department timelines.





What We’re Looking For:

1. Solid experience as a construction scheduler on new homes (residential preferred).

2. Working familiarity with Buildertrend (or with similar platforms, coupled with the ability to become highly proficient in Buildertrend very quickly).

3. Strong understanding of residential construction sequences, trade dependencies, and critical path thinking.

4. Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you will spend a large part of your day coordinating with people who are not in the same room (or the same state).

5. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects.

6. Self-motivated and proactive; you don’t wait to be told something is behind schedule.

7. Reliable remote work setup and availability during Southwest Florida business hours (Eastern Time).





This is a remote role supporting a straightforward, repeatable home-building process. The goal is not to reinvent the schedule every time — it is to execute the existing system with high accuracy, strong communication, and continuous small improvements.

title: Senior AI Systems Architect & Engineer — Data Platform, Agents & Automation
description:
ABOUT ENGAGE



Engage Studio is a Toronto-based custom jewellery company building an AI-native operating system for its sales, marketing, design, production, inventory, and administrative workflows. Our company goal is to create the most thoughtful engagement experience in the world and AI is integral to assisting us achive this.



Our business operations information is currently siloed in multiple systems and platforms. We are undertaking an AI makeover to establish a secure, connected AI foundation that understands the complete client and order journey—from first marketing contact through consultation, design, production, delivery, and future purchases.



We want to unify this environment around a shared data and AI foundation. Our objective is not to add another disconnected AI tool. We want to build production AI systems and agents that can progressively replace redundant SaaS platforms, manual data entry, and fragmented workflows.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are a senior, hands-on AI engineer who can architect and build this system. You investigate unfamiliar systems, identify root causes, and turn complex business needs into maintainable production software. You communicate trade-offs clearly, challenge weak assumptions constructively, and take ownership from discovery through architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, training, and handover.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will design a unified AI-native operating layer consisting of shared data services, domain models, APIs, event-driven workflows, specialized agents, and role-based interfaces. The system must connect information across the complete client and order journey while preserving security, traceability, human oversight, and operational reliability.



You will also identify where existing platforms should:

• Remain the authoritative system of record.

• Be integrated temporarily.

• Be reduced to a limited function.

• Be replaced by purpose-built AI agents and internal applications.

• Be retired after their data and workflows have been safely migrated.



Platform consolidation must be evidence-based and incremental. We do not want a risky, simultaneous replacement of every system.



Core responsibilities will require you to:

• Define canonical data models and identifiers for clients, leads, appointments, orders, stones, designs, CAD files, vendors, invoices, payments, shipments, and related entities.

• Establish data ownership, lineage, reconciliation, and source-of-truth rules.

• Design the appropriate operational data platform using technologies such as PostgreSQL, object storage, search, vector retrieval, event queues, and workflow orchestration where justified.

• Build reliable integrations with authentication, idempotency, retries, monitoring, audit logs, and failure recovery.

• Design and implement production AI agents using tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, deterministic validation, and human approval.

• Build shared agent tools and services instead of duplicating integrations for every use case.

• Create role-based internal interfaces and work queues for sales, production, design, administration, and management.

• Implement automated evaluations, data-quality checks, access controls, and observability.

• Document the architecture, code, data models, operating procedures, and platform-replacement roadmap.

The engineer must determine which capabilities require an LLM, conventional application logic, workflow automation, statistical models, computer vision, or human judgment. We are not looking to force an LLM into every process.



MINUMUM REQUIREMENTS



• You must work during our business hours (9:30am to 6pm EST)

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript software engineering.

• LLM APIs, tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, evaluations, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

• Data engineering, relational modelling, SQL, and PostgreSQL or comparable databases.

• API, webhook, database, document, and event-driven integrations.

• Identity resolution, data lineage, reconciliation, and conflict handling.

• Queues, idempotency, retries, monitoring, logging, and failure recovery.

• Secure handling of confidential business and customer data.

• Role-based access control, auditability, and credential management.

• Git-based development, automated testing, deployment, and documentation.



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



• Salesforce, 
, NocoBase, n8n, WordPress, Google Workspace, Calendly, WhatsApp, or similar integrations.

• ERP, CRM, manufacturing, inventory or production systems.

• Multimodal AI, document extraction, transcription, image similarity, or computer vision.

• Vector and hybrid search.

• CAD, 3D files, technical catalogues, or product information management.

• Marketing attribution, forecasting, anomaly detection, and financial reconciliation.

• Experience replacing third-party SaaS workflows with internal applications or AI-enabled systems.



WHAT WE OFFER:



100,000 to 230,000php per month salary (for full-time based on qualification assessed)



Upon successful passing of a probationary period:



13th month bonus pay (pro-rated depending on start date)

SSS premium benefit

PhilHealth premium benefit

Private health insurance



HOW TO APPLY



Please put the following phrase in the subject heading: CONNECTED AI FOUNDATION



Please provide:

1. A short video walkthrough showing the most sophisticated production AI system you personally built.

2. An example where you replaced or consolidated existing software platforms, including the migration strategy and measurable result.

3. An example of a system you inherited from another developer. Explain how you understood it, collaborated with its existing owner, and made changes without destabilizing it.



Shortlisted candidates will be given a paid, time-boxed exercise to complete. We will assess architecture, implementation skill, speed, reliability, systems thinking, communication, and judgment—not presentation polish alone.

title: Long Form Youtube Content Editor
description:
About the Role



We're a Info Marketing Agency producing long-form YouTube videos for a growing roster of clients. We're hiring one editor to take ownership of two client channels, delivering one finished video per client per week (2 videos/week total). Finished runtime is typically 9–20 minutes.



This is not a gig-by-gig arrangement. You're being brought on for a consistent weekly base pay, with the same two channels every week, so you learn each client's voice, pacing, and preferences instead of starting cold on every project. As we grow, there's room to take on more channels at a higher rate.



The Editing Style (please read this part)



We are not looking for over-produced, hyper-edited, effect-heavy content. Our style is raw and realistic — it should feel like a real person talking, not a motion graphics reel.



What that actually means day to day:



Clean, straightforward cuts that keep the video moving

Removing dead space, filler, stumbles, and mistakes

Accurate, well-timed captions

Tasteful pop-ups, b-roll, images, and light text callouts where they support the point

Simple zooms and cuts for emphasis

Basic audio cleanup and consistent levels

Light color correction so footage looks natural



What we don't want: constant meme-stacking, whooshes on every cut, aggressive zoom-punch on every sentence, or anything that pulls attention away from the speaker. Restraint is the skill here.



What You'll Be Responsible For

Editing 2 long-form videos per week (one per client) to final, upload-ready delivery

Hitting agreed weekly deadlines consistently

Following each client's style guide / reference videos

Handling one round of revisions per video

Organizing project files and delivering in the correct export specs

Communicating clearly if something is unclear or a deadline is at risk

What We're Looking For



Required:



Demonstrable experience editing long-form YouTube content (not just Reels/TikToks — please don't apply with only short-form work)

Fluency in your editing software of choice (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro)

Strong sense of pacing — knowing what to cut and what to leave in

Clean, accurate captioning

Reliable internet and a machine that can handle long-form projects without constant crashes

Solid written English and responsive communication

Ability to commit to the same weekly output every week



Nice to have:



Experience with talking-head, podcast, vlog, or educational/business channels

Basic thumbnail support

Familiarity with YouTube retention basics (hooks, cold opens, chapter pacing)

Light sound design and stock footage sourcing

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

Predictable income — a fixed weekly base rate, not feast-or-famine project work

Stable workload — you know exactly what's on your plate each week

Long-term — we want an editor who stays and grows with us, not a one-off hire

Room to scale — more channels and higher pay as you prove reliability

How to Apply



Send your application with all of the following. Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.



Your portfolio — links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited (9+ minutes). Please note specifically what you did on each one, since we know editors often work as part of a team.

Your software and current editing setup (computer specs + internet speed).

Your realistic weekly capacity — how many long-form videos you can deliver per week alongside your existing commitments.

Your expected weekly rate in USD for 2 videos per week.

Your typical turnaround time for a 15-minute video, from receiving raw footage to first draft.



Include the word "PACING" at the top of your message so we know you read the full post.



We'll review portfolios first, then move a short list to a quick call and a short paid test edit.

Our WooCommerce website has already been **partially built**, but it still requires further development and work before it is where we want it to be.



Initially, part of your role will be to **help us finish, improve and build out the existing website**, before moving into ongoing management and development.

Ideally, you will be confident enough with WordPress and WooCommerce to make improvements independently, while also communicating with us if more advanced development work is required.

For example, when we introduce a new product range, we would like you to be able to:

* Windows & doors

You don't need to already know every building product. However, you must be willing to **learn our products and understand our customers**.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, you will have experience with:



* Instagram

*

* WordPress

* WooCommerce

* Canva or similar graphic design software

* Reels / short-form video editing

* Product uploads and e-commerce management

* Basic website design

* Basic SEO

* Content planning

* Digital marketing

* Growing business social media accounts



Experience working with a **builders merchant, construction company, home improvement business, landscaping company, e-commerce business or other trade-related company** would be a major advantage.



As the majority of our customers are UK based, **excellent written English is essential**. Content must sound natural and professional to a British audience.



What We Will Provide
