title: AI-Enhanced SEO, GEO & Online Visibility Specialist
description:
Natural Renewals is a growing U.S.-based health and wellness company and the company behind My Moss Sea Moss Gel.



We are looking for a smart, resourceful SEO, GEO and Online Visibility Specialist to help more people discover My Moss across the internet.



This is not a basic blog-writing SEO role.



We are not looking for someone who only changes meta descriptions, writes generic AI articles or builds random backlinks.



We want someone who thinks deeply about modern online visibility:



Where are people searching for sea moss?



Which websites, Reddit threads, TikToks, YouTube videos, articles and AI search results influence what they buy?



Which competitors are showing up where we are not?



Why are they winning?



How do we ethically earn visibility in the places where customers are already looking?



Your main goal:



Help Natural Renewals and My Moss become more visible across Google, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity, blogs, publications, directories, product guides and other discovery channels.



AI proficiency is important, but this is primarily an SEO and online visibility role.



We are not looking for an AI generalist learning SEO on the job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will be responsible for:



* SEO and keyword research

* Finding high-value keywords and search topics we can realistically win

* Improving existing website pages for SEO

* Finding content gaps and new page opportunities

* Researching buyer-intent, comparison, problem-solution and social search keywords

* Researching TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and social search trends related to sea moss, wellness, functional foods and customer problems or benefits

* Finding backlink, brand mention and digital PR opportunities

* Finding opportunities for My Moss, Natural Renewals, our products or our founder to be featured in articles, product guides, expert roundups, podcasts, gift guides, newsletters and relevant media coverage

* Pursuing placements, mentions and coverage from discovery through outreach and follow-up

* Researching how we can appear more often in ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity and other AI-powered search tools

* Auditing consistency of Natural Renewals and My Moss information across our website, social profiles, retailers, directories, listings and third-party sources

* Researching competitors and identifying where they get traffic, backlinks, mentions, social visibility and AI search visibility

* Conducting outreach to bloggers, websites, publications and potential partners

* Executing approved SEO and visibility initiatives, not just identifying them

* Tracking outreach, backlinks, mentions, rankings, opportunities and progress

* Tracking branded search growth, referring traffic, earned mentions and AI-search visibility where practical

* Providing short weekly reports showing what was completed, what changed, what was learned and what opportunities were found



AI LEVERAGE EXPECTATION



We expect this person to use AI tools intelligently to work faster and better.



AI may be used for:



* Keyword clustering

* Competitor research

* Content gap analysis

* Reddit and social listening

* AI search testing

* Outreach research

* Digital PR research

* Entity consistency audits

* Reporting

* Organizing large amounts of information

* Finding patterns across large amounts of research



GEO means generative engine optimization: improving how the brand appears in AI-powered search tools like ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity and similar platforms.



However, we do NOT want someone who blindly relies on AI.



We do not want:



* Generic AI articles

* Copied AI content

* Fake reviews

* Fake Reddit activity

* Spam comments

* Low-quality backlinks

* Automated directory blasting

* Unverified AI output

* Generic SEO reports with no real thinking



AI should support your judgment, not replace it.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



* Strong in SEO fundamentals

* Excellent at internet research

* Resourceful and independent

* Excellent at written English

* Familiar with Google Search Console and keyword research tools

* Familiar with Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, Google and social search

* Comfortable using AI tools for research, analysis and productivity

* Organized and able to document work clearly

* Able to prioritize high-value opportunities instead of just staying busy

* Comfortable executing approved ideas, not just making reports

* Strategic and practical about what will actually move results



Experience with e-commerce, wellness, food, functional foods, consumer products, natural products, digital PR or content marketing is a major plus.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



This role is not for you if:



* Your SEO strategy is just writing AI blog posts

* You focus on low-quality backlinks

* You use spammy SEO tactics

* You create fake Reddit conversations or fake customer accounts

* You cannot explain why an SEO opportunity matters

* You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day

* You are an AI generalist with little SEO experience

* You are good at making reports but weak at executing



We want real online authority and visibility.



Quality matters more than quantity.



HOW TO APPLY



Important:



At the very beginning of your application, write:



MY MOSS



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.



Please include:



1. A short introduction



2. Your SEO and online visibility experience



3. Examples of websites, brands or projects you helped grow



4. Measurable results, if available



5. SEO tools you have used



6. AI tools you use and how you use them for SEO, research, analysis or reporting



7. One SEO or visibility opportunity you found for a previous company that most people would have missed. What did you do with it?



8. If you had only 20 hours per week for the first 60 days, what 3 areas would you prioritize to increase My Moss's online visibility, how would you divide your time and why?



9. Tell us about a time you personally executed an SEO, outreach or visibility opportunity from research through completion



10. Your expected monthly salary for 20 to 25 hours per week



Applications that are generic, copied or clearly AI-generated without real thought will be ignored.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small paid test.



The test will be practical and focused.



It will not be a giant report.



It will cover:



* 5 high-value SEO or visibility opportunities

* Competitor visibility research

* Google, AI search and social discovery research

* AI workflow and a short 14-day action plan



We are looking for someone who can repeatedly answer one question:



Where are customers discovering sea moss online, who currently owns those discovery channels, why are they winning, and what specific actions can we take to earn visibility in those places?



At the very beginning of your application, write:



MY MOSS



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.

title: Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a talented and versatile Video Editor to join our growing team. If you're passionate about creating high-quality, engaging video content and have advanced skills in editing, motion graphics, color grading, and AI-assisted content creation, we'd love to hear from you.



The ideal candidate has a strong creative eye, excellent technical skills, and the ability to transform raw footage into polished, attention-grabbing videos for multiple platforms.



Position Details



Position: Skilled Video Editor

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: 100% Remote

Schedule: Monday – Friday | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Compensation: $5.00 – $7.00 USD per hour, depending on experience



Responsibilities



Edit and assemble raw footage into polished, engaging final videos.

Perform professional color correction and color grading for a consistent visual style.

Create motion graphics, animations, text effects, image pop-ins, and dynamic transitions using Adobe After Effects.

Enhance videos with sound design, music, sound effects, audio cleanup, and mixing.

Perform green screen (chroma key) editing and compositing.

Create and integrate AI-generated images and video assets into projects.

Produce and optimize short-form content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Design supporting graphics, overlays, and eye-catching thumbnails.

Organize project files and maintain efficient editing workflows.

Collaborate with the creative team to deliver content on schedule.



Qualifications



Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.

Strong experience with Adobe After Effects for motion graphics and animation.

Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.

Strong color correction and color grading skills.

Experience with professional sound design and audio mixing.

Experience with green screen keying and video compositing.

Experience using AI image and video generation tools such as Midjourney, Runway, Sora, Kling, or similar.

Proven experience creating content for social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Strong attention to detail and storytelling ability.

Excellent time management and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently while meeting deadlines.

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a dedicated workspace.



You're a Great Fit If You



Have a strong portfolio or demo reel that showcases your editing, motion graphics, and creative storytelling skills.

Work efficiently and consistently meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

Stay up to date with the latest video editing trends, AI tools, and social media best practices.

Communicate professionally and take constructive feedback well.

Are creative, detail-oriented, and passionate about producing engaging content that captures attention.

title: Virtual Client Outreach, Intake & CRM Coordinator
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



KT Everyday Tax & Business Advising is a growing U.S.-based tax, accounting, and business-services company. We help individuals and business owners with tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, business support, and related professional services.



We are looking for a dependable, confident, and highly organized Virtual Client Outreach, Intake & CRM Coordinator. This person will help us reconnect with prior clients, respond to new inquiries, conduct basic intake, schedule appointments, and maintain accurate records in our CRM.



This is not a passive data-entry position. You must be comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients by telephone, following up consistently, asking appropriate questions, and moving qualified prospects to the next step.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Call, text, and
 prior clients and prospective clients using approved scripts.

Re-engage inactive leads and clients who may need tax, accounting, bookkeeping, payroll, or business services.

Respond promptly and professionally to new inquiries.

Conduct basic intake and prequalification calls.

Ask approved questions to understand the prospect’s needs.

Schedule qualified appointments and paid consultations.

Confirm appointments and follow up with cancellations and no-shows.

Send approved scheduling, payment, document-upload, and service-information links.

Follow up on unsigned engagement letters and unpaid deposits.

Update contact information, notes, tags, tasks, and pipeline stages in the CRM.

Make sure every active lead has an assigned next action and follow-up date.

Place unresponsive prospects into the appropriate follow-up campaign.

Escalate complex, sensitive, or technical questions to management.

Prepare daily activity reports and weekly pipeline summaries.

Protect confidential client and company information.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



Excellent spoken and written English.

Clear, professional, and confident telephone voice.

Previous experience in appointment setting, customer service, inside sales, lead nurturing, or client intake.

Strong follow-up and documentation skills.

Comfortable making outbound calls to U.S.-based prospects and clients.

Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural and personable.

Experience using a CRM.

Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written procedures.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, headset, and quiet working environment.

Able to work independently and meet daily performance expectations.

Available for scheduled working hours that overlap with U.S. Central Time.

Willing to complete training and accept coaching.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience with GoHighLevel, LeadConnector, or a similar CRM.

Experience working for a tax, accounting, bookkeeping, mortgage, legal, financial, or other professional-services company.

Experience sending appointment reminders and following up on proposals or payments.

Experience with Google Workspace, Zoom, and Microsoft Office.

Sales or client-conversion experience.



IMPORTANT ROLE LIMITATIONS



This is an administrative and client-coordination position. You will not provide tax, accounting, legal, financial, or mortgage advice. You will not independently determine pricing, promise results, interpret client documents, or answer technical questions. These matters must be escalated to an authorized professional.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Your performance will be measured using:



Outreach attempts completed.

Meaningful client conversations.

Qualified appointments scheduled.

Appointment attendance rate.

Follow-ups completed on time.

Accuracy and completeness of CRM notes.

Leads moved through the correct pipeline stages.

Engagements and deposits generated from qualified appointments.

Responsiveness, professionalism, and reliability.

Compliance with scripts, procedures, and confidentiality requirements.



WHAT WE OFFER



Stable, long-term part-time opportunity.

Consistent weekly schedule.

Paid training on our services, scripts, and systems.

Opportunity for increased hours based on performance and company growth.

Opportunity to grow into a senior intake, client-success, or team-lead position.

Supportive but accountable working environment.

Performance incentives may be available after the introductory period.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



A brief introduction describing your relevant experience.

Your résumé.

A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be effective when speaking with U.S.-based clients.

A list of the CRMs and communication systems you have used.

Your required hourly rate in U.S. dollars.

Your availability in U.S. Central Time.

A description of your internet connection, computer, headset, and backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

Your answer to the following situation:



“A prior tax client says, ‘I already have someone helping me this year, so I’m not interested.’ How would you respond professionally while keeping the relationship open?”



To confirm that you read the entire posting, begin your application subject line with:



KT EVERYDAY – CLIENT OUTREACH



Applications that do not include the requested voice recording, scenario response, and subject line will not be considered.



HIRING PROCESS



Selected applicants will complete:



An initial application review.

A short video interview.

A mock client outreach call.

A basic CRM and written-communication assessment.

Reference and background verification, when applicable.

A 60-day introductory performance period.



We are looking for someone who communicates well, documents everything, follows instructions, accepts feedback, and takes responsibility for completing assigned work.

title: Real Estate Prospecting and warm dialer
description:
Real Estate Inside Sales / Lead Follow-Up Virtual Assistant



Company: Raintown Realty

Position: Full-Time Virtual Assistant – Inside Sales & Lead Follow-Up

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

Compensation: Hourly wage based on experience + performance bonuses for qualified transfers and closed transactions



About the Position



Raintown Realty is looking for a dependable, highly motivated Virtual Assistant to join our real estate team. This is not simply an administrative VA position. The primary focus of this role is answering incoming calls, making outbound calls, following up with prospective buyers and sellers, maintaining our lead database, and helping connect qualified opportunities with our real estate agents.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable spending a significant portion of each day on the phone and who understands that consistent follow-up is one of the most important parts of the job.



The right person is professional, personable, organized, dependable, and persistent without being overly aggressive.



Primary Responsibilities

Answer incoming phone calls professionally and promptly.

Make a minimum of 100 outbound calls per workday.

Contact and follow up with buyer and seller leads.

Speak confidently with prospective clients and determine their real estate needs and timeline.

Identify qualified opportunities and transfer or schedule them with the appropriate Raintown Realty agent.

Consistently follow up with leads who are not yet ready to buy or sell.

Work inside Follow Up Boss to manage leads, conversations, notes, tasks, appointments, and follow-up.

Work with leads generated and nurtured through Ylopo.

Keep detailed and accurate notes after conversations.

Update lead stages, statuses, and contact information.

Complete scheduled follow-up tasks every day.

Respond quickly to new lead inquiries.

Help ensure that opportunities do not fall through the cracks because of poor or inconsistent follow-up.

Communicate regularly with agents and management regarding qualified opportunities and important lead activity.

What We Are Looking For

Exceptional English Communication



Exceptional spoken English is required. You must be able to communicate naturally, confidently, and professionally with clients in the United States.



We are looking for someone who:



Speaks English fluently and clearly.

Has excellent listening and conversational skills.

Is easy for American clients to understand over the phone.

Can build rapport quickly.

Does not sound as though they are simply reading from a script.

Can comfortably handle unexpected questions and keep a conversation moving.



Excellent written English is also important for texting,
ing, documenting conversations, and communicating with our agents.



Strong Phone Skills



You must be comfortable making a large number of calls every day.



This position requires someone who can:



Consistently complete 100+ outbound calls per day.

Handle rejection without becoming discouraged.

Have natural conversations rather than simply reading a script.

Ask good questions.

Listen carefully.

Recognize potential buying or selling opportunities.

Follow up repeatedly when appropriate.

Know when a prospect is ready to speak with an agent.



If you dislike being on the phone or are uncomfortable making outbound calls, this will not be the right position for you.



Dependability



Reliability is extremely important to us.



You will be expected to:



Be logged in and ready to work on time every day.

Maintain consistent attendance.

Work your complete scheduled shift.

Communicate immediately if an emergency affects your ability to work.

Complete assigned tasks without needing constant reminders.



Our agents depend on this position, so attendance and punctuality are essential.



Preferred Experience



Candidates with the following experience will receive additional consideration:



Follow Up Boss

Ylopo

Real estate lead generation

Real estate ISA or inside sales experience

Cold calling

Appointment setting

Lead qualification

CRM management

Buyer and seller lead follow-up

Calling U.S.-based consumers



Experience with Follow Up Boss and Ylopo is strongly preferred. Candidates without direct experience may still be considered if they have strong real estate calling, CRM, or inside-sales experience and can learn new systems quickly.



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by more than simply the number of calls made. We are looking for someone who produces meaningful conversations and opportunities.



Performance may include:



Minimum of 100 outbound calls per day

Inbound call responsiveness

Number of meaningful conversations

Qualified lead transfers

Appointments or opportunities created

Consistency of follow-up

Accuracy of CRM records

Closed transactions resulting from transferred or nurtured leads

Attendance and punctuality

Compensation



Compensation consists of:



Hourly Pay + Performance Bonuses



Hourly compensation will depend on experience, English communication ability, real estate knowledge, and familiarity with Follow Up Boss and Ylopo.



Additional bonuses are available based on performance, including:



Qualified lead transfers

Successful appointments/opportunities

Closed real estate transactions resulting from your leads



This gives strong performers the opportunity to earn significantly more than their base hourly wage.



Schedule



Monday through Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



Applicants must be able to reliably work these hours.



The Person Who Will Succeed Here



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work.



You should be someone who thinks:



“There are people in this database who are going to buy or sell a home. My job is to find them, build a relationship with them, follow up with them, and make sure we are there when they are ready.”



You should be persistent, competitive, friendly, organized, coachable, and comfortable being measured by results.



This is an important position within our company, and there is an opportunity to grow with us for someone who consistently performs.



How to Apply



When applying, please include:



A brief description of your previous VA, real estate, inside-sales, or calling experience.

Your experience with Follow Up Boss.

Your experience with Ylopo.

How many outbound calls you are accustomed to making in a normal workday.

Your expected hourly rate.

A short voice recording introducing yourself and describing your previous work experience.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of the Raintown Realty team—not someone looking for a temporary position.

title: Amazon Brand Growth & Operations Manager — Multi-Channel FBA, Attribution, TikTok Shop
description:
Amazon Brand Growth & Operations Manager — Multi-Channel FBA, Attribution, TikTok Shop



We're a new premium skincare brand launching on Amazon (target: late September) and looking for someone to own our Seller Central operations and actively help us grow and brand-build — not just execute tasks.



This is NOT a product research or sourcing role. Our product is already manufactured and locked. We need an operator-strategist who can run the account day to day, track where our growth is coming from, and bring ideas for making the brand stand out and spread.



What You'll Own



Seller Central & Multi-Channel Operations



Manage FBA inventory, restock planning, and shipment scheduling

Prepare our account for Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) so the same FBA inventory can eventually fulfill TikTok Shop and Shopify orders

Monitor account health, stranded inventory, and listing issues



Amazon Attribution & Tracking



Set up and manage Amazon Attribution tags for off-Amazon traffic (influencers, social content, paid social, affiliate links)

Track which external sources actually drive sales, not just clicks

Understand the Brand Referral Bonus program and how it affects attribution decisions



Brand Growth & Strategy



Work directly with the founder on positioning and how to make the brand more visible and shareable

Bring real ideas for content, explore Amazon Vine, creator partnerships, and campaigns that could help a new product get discovered

Help plan and interpret Sponsored Brands/PPC campaigns (basic to intermediate campaign management)



Inventory Management



Forecast demand and set reorder points to avoid stockouts or overstock

Coordinate shipment timing with our manufacturer



TikTok Shop (Future Phase)



Help set up and launch our TikTok Shop storefront once we're ready

Test MCF middleware (e.g. WebBee, ByteStand) connecting Amazon FBA inventory to TikTok Shop

Support creator/affiliate coordination once that program is live

What We're Looking For



You should have:



Hands-on experience running an Amazon Seller Central account (not just researching products)

PPC campaign strategies

Real experience with Amazon Attribution — setting it up, using it, explaining what it tells you

Experience with inventory/demand forecasting for FBA

Some experience with Sponsored Ads / PPC campaign basics

A genuine interest in branding and growth — you should be able to point to a brand or product you helped make more visible, not just "ran the ads"

Bonus: experience with TikTok Shop, MCF, or Helium 10 / similar tools

Strong written English and comfort working independently with a small, hands-on founder team

What We're NOT Looking For

Product research / sourcing specialists (we have that covered separately)

Someone who only wants to follow a checklist — we want a thinking partner on growth

Hours & Pay

title: Outbound Cold-Calling / Outreach Specialist
description:
About Neugent

Neugent AI LLC is a small AI consulting and engineering shop -- "AI agents that actually work." We build custom chatbots, voice agents, and automation for businesses that know what they want automated but don't have the engineering resources to build it themselves.



The role

We're looking for someone based in the Philippines to run outbound cold-calling for Neugent, full workday, timed to hit prime calling hours across all four continental US time zones (EST, CST, MST, PST) back-to-back.



What you'd actually be doing

- Cold calling prospects across a schedule built to hit EST/CST/MST/PST prime hours in sequence

- Researching good niches to call into using our own prospect-scoring criteria (decision-maker accessibility, budget, urgency, revenue fit, sales cycle speed, competitive saturation, referenceability)

- Writing and refining call scripts that hold up over real calls, not just read well on paper

- Logging call outcomes and prospect status so we can see pipeline movement without having to ask



What we're looking for

- No accent -- needs to sound natural to a US-based prospect picking up a cold call

- Good with words -- comfortable improvising past a script when a call goes off-plan

- Knows how to research good niches, or can be trained fast on our scoring criteria

- Knows how to write good scripts, or learns it quickly by listening to their own call recordings

- Good English, spoken and written

- A voice that carries authority -- prospects need to take the call seriously in the first 10 seconds (use the word "cadence" in your application so we know you read this)



Schedule

Full workday, scheduled to cover EST through PST prime calling windows -- maximum coverage of the US business day.



How we screen

1. Apply with at least 8 Apply Points attached to your application.

2. Short written application

3. A voice sample or short recorded call

4. A real test task: we'll give you a handful of sample prospects and our scoring criteria and ask you to rank them -- this is literally the "research good niches" part of the job, not a hypothetical.

title: Real Time Review Specialist
description:
Job Summary

SpartanX is seeking a highly detail-oriented Real-Time Review Specialist to review residential solar projects as they move through the sales and project pipeline. This role serves as an important quality checkpoint, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete, and compliant before projects move to the next stage.



This is not a sales position. We're looking for someone who understands residential solar, knows what a clean and complete project should look like, and can quickly identify issues that could create delays, rework, or compliance concerns downstream.



What You'll Do

- Conduct real-time reviews of residential solar project submissions

- Review contracts, financing documentation, proposals, system information, and supporting project documents

- Verify submissions are complete and accurate before projects are approved to move forward

- Identify missing documentation, discrepancies, errors, and potential compliance concerns

- Return incomplete or inaccurate submissions with clear, actionable notes for correction

- Review project information for consistency across contracts, proposals, financing documents, and internal systems

- Maintain accurate documentation of reviews, findings, and outcomes

- Monitor recurring submission issues and communicate trends to leadership

- Work closely with Sales, Operations, Compliance, and Training teams to improve submission quality

- Apply company review standards consistently across all projects

- Help prevent downstream project delays by catching issues early in the process



What We're Looking For

- Previous residential solar industry experience strongly preferred

- Experience in solar operations, quality control, compliance, project review, sales support, or a related function

- Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle

- Familiarity with solar contracts, proposals, and project documentation

- Knowledge of common solar financing structures, including loans, PPAs, and cash projects, preferred

- Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies quickly

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Ability to make objective decisions based on established requirements and standards

- Strong written communication skills

- Ability to manage a high volume of reviews while maintaining accuracy

- Experience working with CRM systems and solar proposal platforms preferred



What Success Looks Like

- Accurate and consistent project reviews

- Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality

- Fewer downstream errors and project delays

- Clear feedback that allows issues to be corrected quickly

- Consistent application of company and compliance standards

- Identification of recurring issues before they become larger operational problems



Why SpartanX?

The earlier we catch a problem, the easier it is to solve.

As a Real-Time Review Specialist, you'll serve as an important checkpoint between a completed sale and the teams responsible for moving that project forward. Your ability to catch missing information, identify inconsistencies, and maintain high standards directly impacts project efficiency, compliance, and the homeowner experience.



If you know residential solar, have an exceptional eye for detail, and aren't afraid to stop a project when something isn't right, we want to hear from you.

We expect the developer to recommend the best WordPress architecture for this.



### This is NOT necessarily an e-commerce website.



Customers do not need to purchase a swimming pool or $15,000+ Hot Tub directly online.



The objective is:



### DISCOVER ? COMPARE ? GET INTERESTED ? CONTACT US ? GET A QUOTE ? BUY



---



# PRODUCT SEARCH & FILTERING



We would like customers to easily browse and compare our products.



For example, Hot Tubs could potentially be filtered by:



* Brand

* Number of seats

* Lounger / No Lounger

* Size

* Collection

* Features



Pools could potentially be filtered by:



* Size

* Shape

* Length

* Width

* Built-in spa

* Tanning ledge

* Features

---



# REAL SENSASSION PROJECTS

We want sections such as:



### BEFORE & AFTER



### RECENT POOL INSTALLATIONS



### HOT TUB INSTALLATIONS



### SWIM SPA INSTALLATIONS

For example:



A customer looking at a specific Latham pool model could see:



**“See this Latham pool installed by Sensassion Pool & Spa.”**



We want customers to see that we actually install these products locally.



---



# LEAD GENERATION — HIGH PRIORITY



The website cannot simply look beautiful.



### IT MUST GENERATE LEADS.



We want clear and strategically placed calls-to-action throughout the website:



**GET A FREE POOL QUOTE**



**REQUEST PRICING**



**CHECK AVAILABILITY**



**ASK ABOUT THIS MODEL**



**VISIT OUR SHOWROOM**



**CALL US**

Our objective is:



### WEBSITE VISITOR ? LEAD ? APPOINTMENT ? QUOTE ? CUSTOMER



---



# LOCAL SEO — VERY IMPORTANT



We want to build strong organic visibility throughout our ACTUAL service area.



## PALM BEACH COUNTY



Including important markets such as:

Including:

---



# SEO TARGETS

**
**

title: Experienced B2B Cold Caller / Sales Closer – UK Construction (Base + Commission)
description:
We are a UK-based multi-trade construction and refurbishment contractor 

(Cambridgeshire, Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire and the London corridor).

outbound pipeline from scratch.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL ROLE. Please do not apply if you have less 

than 2 years of real sales experience with numbers you can prove.

 property managers, letting agents, block

- Keep the CRM (GoHighLevel) clean and updated daily

- Report weekly on prospects added, calls made, appointments booked



Full training is provided on where to find leads and how we position 

the company. You bring the sales ability — we show you the sources.

- Excellent spoken English. You will cold call UK business clients daily. 

  Neutral, confident, professional.

PAY

Base salary paid monthly, plus commission on every deal that closes. 

Top performers earn significantly more than base. We pay on time, every time.

Applications that do not follow these steps will be deleted without reply.

No video = no interview. This is a sales role; I need to hear you sell



This is a very important role in the company, depending on candidate it can turn into a full time role



Looking doe somebody hungry for growth who wants to earn more rather than just the base salary

• Work directly with MSP clients and end customers to execute solutions and improvements.



Microsoft 365 (Core Focus Area)

Availability & Support Expectations

________________________________________

Qualifications

Required Experience

o Microsoft 365 (all major workloads and admin portals)

 and data migrations

# Remote Medical Credentialing & Prior Authorization Specialist



**Specialty Medical Practice | Remote | Part-Time | $5.00/hour**



Seeking an experienced **Medical Credentialing and Prior Authorization Specialist** to support a busy multi-physician specialty medical practice.



This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized and comfortable managing **provider credentialing, prior authorizations, insurance verification, and payer follow-up**.



Credentialing volume may fluctuate throughout the year, so the candidate should also be comfortable assisting with additional insurance-related administrative responsibilities.



### Responsibilities



**Provider Credentialing**



* Complete initial credentialing and recredentialing applications

* Manage provider enrollment with insurance plans, medical groups, hospitals, and IPAs

* Maintain and update CAQH profiles

* Track credentialing and recredentialing deadlines

* Follow up on pending applications and missing documentation

* Maintain organized credentialing spreadsheets and tracking systems

* Monitor expirations and upcoming renewals

* Communicate with payers and organizations regarding enrollment status



**Prior Authorizations**



* Submit prior authorization requests for office and specialty services

* Verify authorization requirements with insurance plans

* Follow up on pending authorizations

* Obtain supporting clinical documentation when required

* Track authorization status and expiration dates

* Document authorization numbers and payer communications

* Escalate urgent or delayed authorizations appropriately



**Insurance Verification**



* Verify patient eligibility and benefits

* Review copays, coinsurance, deductibles, and plan limitations

* Confirm HMO/IPA assignments and referral requirements

* Verify Medicare and Medicare Advantage coverage

* Communicate insurance issues to the practice before services are provided



**Additional Support**



* Assist with disability forms and related administrative paperwork

* Maintain organized documentation of payer communications

* Assist with other insurance-related projects during high-volume periods



### Requirements



* Previous U.S. medical credentialing experience required

* Experience completing provider enrollment and recredentialing

* Experience with **CAQH**

* Prior authorization experience strongly preferred

* Insurance verification experience required

* Familiarity with Medicare, Medicare Advantage, HMOs, Medi-Cal HMOs, commercial plans, and IPAs

* Excellent organizational and follow-up skills

* Ability to manage multiple deadlines independently

* Strong written and spoken English

* High attention to detail



### Preferred Experience



* Experience supporting specialty physician practices

* California payer and IPA experience

* Cardiothoracic, cardiology, cardiovascular, or surgical practice experience

* Experience completing disability paperwork

* Experience with DrChrono or other U.S. medical EMRs

* Experience maintaining credentialing trackers for multiple physicians



### Schedule



**Remote, part-time position** with availability during **U.S. Pacific Time business hours**.



Hours may increase during periods of heavy credentialing, recredentialing, or authorization volume.



### Compensation



**$5.00 USD per hour**



### How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your current **CV/resume**

* A short **introductory video**

* A brief description of your credentialing experience

* Which payers, IPAs, and credentialing platforms you have worked with

* Your experience with prior authorizations and insurance verification

* Any experience with disability forms

* The medical specialties you have previously supported



**Candidates who can independently manage credentialing deadlines while also assisting with prior authorizations and insurance verification will receive priority consideration.**

title: Top Video Editors 900$ per month
description:
We run a large short-form content operation, our clips pull millions of views across a big network of accounts. This is a standard full-time position with a fixed monthly salary, not freelance, not per project. You work set hours, you get paid the same every month, steady work every single week. Long-term position, we only take the best.



The work: Editing OmeTV footage into short viral clips. You get 30-60 min recorded sessions, you watch them, find the best moments, and cut each moment into two files: a full edit (vertical crop, sound effects timed on the reactions, background music, zooms, captions, clean coloring) and a fast raw cut of the same moment.



The style: High pacing, tight cuts, movement, the viewer must stay locked in from the first second to the last. But balanced, not overdone, a clip stuffed with effects is as bad as a boring one. Perfect rhythm, not chaos. And every clip must tell a story, beginning, punchline, payoff. If you can't make a story out of a video, don't apply.



What you must know: Short-form editing properly: cropping to 9:16 without stretching faces, timing sound effects, word-by-word captions, keeping quality crispy. CapCut is enough if you know what you're doing.



What we give you: All the footage (always more than you can finish) and exact documents on how we want everything.



The pay: $900 a month, fixed. 8 hours a day, 6 days a week, with a daily minimum of clips you need to deliver. Paid twice a month, on the 1st and 15th, always on time.



Requirements: Full-time, not a side gig, if you can only give 2-3 hours a day don't apply. Fast stable internet and a PC that handles editing smoothly.



Every clip goes through review and only approved work is paid, but don't stress it, we approve everything as long as the quality is there, in practice 90-100% of clips pass. We choose very few people and we keep the ones who deliver.
